content.shloka:
Shri Guru charan saroj raj, nij manu mukuru sudhari.
Baranau Raghubar bimal yash, jo dayaku phal chari.
content.meaning: After cleansing the mirror of my mind with the dust of the lotus feet of Shri Guru, I describe the pure glory of Shri Rama, who bestows the four fruits of life.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Guru caraṇa saroja raja, nija manu mukuru sudhāri.
Baranau Raghubar bimala yaśa, jo dāyaku phala cāri.

content.shloka:
Buddhiheen tanu janike, sumirau Pavan Kumar.
Bal buddhi vidya dehu mohi, harahu kalesh bikaar.
content.meaning: Knowing myself to be ignorant, I remember Hanuman, the son of the wind god. Grant me strength, wisdom, and knowledge, and remove all my afflictions and impurities.
content.transliteration:
Buddhihīna tanu jānike, sumirau Pavana Kumāra.
Bala buddhi vidyā dehu mohi, harahu kaleśa bikāra.

content.shloka:
Jai Hanuman gyan gun sagar,
Jai Kapis tihun lok ujagar.
Ram doot atulit bal dhama,
Anjani putra Pavan sut nama.
content.meaning: Victory to Hanuman, the ocean of wisdom and virtue. Victory to the lord of monkeys, who illumines the three worlds. You are the messenger of Rama, the abode of immeasurable strength, son of Anjani, known as the son of the wind.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Hanumāna jñāna guṇa sāgara,
Jaya Kapīśa tihun loka ujāgara.
Rāma dūta atulita bala dhāmā,
Añjanī putra Pavana suta nāmā.

content.shloka:
Mahabir bikram Bajrangi,
Kumati nivar sumati ke sangi.
Kanchan baran biraj subesa,
Kanan kundal kunchit kesa.
content.meaning: O great hero of tremendous valor with a body strong as a thunderbolt, you are the dispeller of evil thoughts and the companion of good wisdom. Your complexion is golden and your attire magnificent, with earrings in your ears and curly hair.
content.transliteration:
Mahābīra bikrama Bajaraṅgī,
Kumati nivāra sumati ke saṅgī.
Kañcana barana birāja subesā,
Kānana kuṇḍala kuñcita keśā.

content.shloka:
Hath bajra au dhvaja biraje,
Kandhe moonj janeu saaje.
Shankar suvan Kesari Nandan,
Tej pratap maha jag bandan.
content.meaning: In your hands shine the mace and the banner, and a sacred thread of munja grass adorns your shoulder. You are an incarnation of Shiva and the son of Kesari, your radiance and glory are revered throughout the world.
content.transliteration:
Hātha bajra au dhvajā birājai,
Kāndhe mūnja janeū sājai.
Śaṅkara suvana Kesarī Nandana,
Teja pratāpa mahā jaga bandana.

content.shloka:
Vidyavan guni ati chatur,
Ram kaj karibe ko aatur.
Prabhu charitra sunibe ko rasiya,
Ram Lakhan Sita man basiya.
content.meaning: You are learned, virtuous, and very clever, ever eager to serve the cause of Rama. You delight in hearing the stories of the Lord, and Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita dwell in your heart.
content.transliteration:
Vidyāvāna guṇī ati cātura,
Rāma kāja karibe ko ātura.
Prabhu caritra sunibe ko rasiyā,
Rāma Lakhaṇa Sītā mana basiyā.

content.shloka:
Sukshma roop dhari Siyahi dikhava,
Bikat roop dhari Lanka jarava.
Bhim roop dhari asur sanhare,
Ramchandra ke kaj sanvare.
content.meaning: You appeared before Sita in a tiny form, and in a terrifying form you set Lanka ablaze. In a mighty form you destroyed the demons and accomplished all of Rama's missions.
content.transliteration:
Sūkṣma rūpa dhari Siyahi dikhāvā,
Bikaṭa rūpa dhari Laṅkā jarāvā.
Bhīma rūpa dhari asura saṃhāre,
Rāmacandra ke kāja saṃvāre.

content.shloka:
Laye Sanjivan Lakhan jiyaye,
Shri Raghubir harashi ur laye.
Raghupati kinhi bahut badai,
Tum mam priy Bharat-hi sam bhai.
content.meaning: You brought the Sanjivani herb and revived Lakshmana. Shri Rama embraced you with great joy. Rama praised you greatly, saying you are as dear to him as his brother Bharata.
content.transliteration:
Lāye Sañjīvana Lakhana jiyāye,
Śrī Raghubīra haraṣi ura lāye.
Raghupati kinhī bahuta baḍāī,
Tuma mama priya Bharata-hi sama bhāī.

content.shloka:
Sahas badan tumharo yash gaave,
As kahi Shripati kanth lagave.
Sankadhik Brahmaadi Muneesa,
Narad Sharad sahit Aheesa.
content.meaning: The thousand-headed Shesha sings your glory, and saying this, Lord Vishnu embraced you. Brahma, sages like Sanaka, Narada, Sharada, and the serpent king all praise you.
content.transliteration:
Sahasa badana tumharo yaśa gāvai,
Asa kahi Śrīpati kaṇṭha lagāvai.
Sanakādika Brahmādi Munīśā,
Nārada Śārada sahita Ahīśā.

content.shloka:
Jam Kuber Digpal jahan te,
Kabi kobid kahi sake kahan te.
Tum upkar Sugrivahin keenha,
Ram milaye rajpad deenha.
content.meaning: Yama, Kubera, and the guardians of the directions, poets and scholars -- none can fully describe your glory. You helped Sugriva by introducing him to Rama, who restored his kingdom.
content.transliteration:
Yama Kubera Digapāla jahān te,
Kabi kobida kahi sake kahān te.
Tuma upakāra Sugrīvahi kīnhā,
Rāma milāye rājapada dīnhā.

content.shloka:
Tumharo mantra Vibhishan mana,
Lankeshwar bhaye sab jag jana.
Yug sahasra yojan par Bhanu,
Leelyo tahi madhur phal janu.
content.meaning: Your counsel was taken to heart by Vibhishana, and through you he became the king of Lanka, as the whole world knows. You swallowed the sun, thousands of miles away, mistaking it for a sweet fruit.
content.transliteration:
Tumharo mantra Vibhīṣaṇa mānā,
Laṅkeśvara bhaye saba jaga jānā.
Yuga sahasra yojana para Bhānu,
Līlyo tāhi madhura phala jānū.

content.shloka:
Prabhu mudrika meli mukh mahee,
Jaladhi langhi gaye achraj nahee.
Durgam kaj jagat ke jete,
Sugam anugraha tumhre tete.
content.meaning: Carrying the Lord's ring in your mouth, it was no surprise that you leaped across the ocean. All the difficult tasks in this world become easy with your grace.
content.transliteration:
Prabhu mudrikā meli mukha māhī,
Jaladhi lāṅghi gaye acaraja nāhī.
Durgama kāja jagata ke jete,
Sugama anugraha tumhare tete.

content.shloka:
Ram duare tum rakhvare,
Hot na agya binu paisare.
Sab sukh lahai tumhari sarna,
Tum rakshak kahu ko darna.
content.meaning: You are the guardian at the door of Rama; none can enter without your permission. All happiness is found in your refuge; those under your protection need fear nothing.
content.transliteration:
Rāma duāre tuma rakhavāre,
Hota na ājñā binu paisāre.
Saba sukha lahai tumhārī śaranā,
Tuma rakṣaka kāhū ko ḍaranā.

content.shloka:
Aapan tej samharo aapai,
Teenon lok hank te kanpai.
Bhut pisach nikat nahin aavai,
Mahabir jab naam sunavai.
content.meaning: Only you can control your own splendor; the three worlds tremble at your roar. Ghosts and evil spirits dare not come near when one utters the name of Mahabir.
content.transliteration:
Āpana teja samhāro āpai,
Tīnon loka hāṅka te kāṅpai.
Bhūta piśāca nikaṭa nahi āvai,
Mahābīra jaba nāma sunāvai.

content.shloka:
Naasai rog harai sab peera,
Japat nirantar Hanumat beera.
Sankat te Hanuman chhudavai,
Man kram bachan dhyan jo lavai.
content.meaning: All diseases and pains are destroyed by constantly chanting the name of brave Hanuman. Hanuman rescues from all calamities those who remember him in thought, deed, and word.
content.transliteration:
Nāsai roga harai saba pīrā,
Japata nirantara Hanumata bīrā.
Saṅkaṭa te Hanumāna chuḍāvai,
Mana krama bacana dhyāna jo lāvai.

content.shloka:
Sab par Ram tapasvi Raja,
Tin ke kaj sakal tum saja.
Aur manorath jo koi lavai,
Soi amit jivan phal pavai.
content.meaning: Rama reigns as the supreme ascetic king, and you accomplish all his work. Whoever comes to you with any desire obtains the imperishable fruit of life.
content.transliteration:
Saba para Rāma tapasvi Rājā,
Tina ke kāja sakala tuma sājā.
Aura manoratha jo koī lāvai,
Soī amita jīvana phala pāvai.

content.shloka:
Charon yug partap tumhara,
Hai parsiddh jagat ujiyara.
Sadhu sant ke tum rakhvare,
Asur nikandan Ram dulare.
content.meaning: Your glory spreads across all four ages and is renowned throughout the world. You are the protector of saints and sages, the destroyer of demons, and the beloved of Rama.
content.transliteration:
Cāron yuga paratāpa tumhārā,
Hai parasiddha jagata ujiyārā.
Sādhu santa ke tuma rakhavāre,
Asura nikandana Rāma dulāre.

content.shloka:
Ashta siddhi nav nidhi ke data,
As bar deen Janaki Mata.
Ram rasayan tumhare pasa,
Sada raho Raghupati ke dasa.
content.meaning: Mother Janaki (Sita) granted you the boon of bestowing the eight supernatural powers and nine treasures. You hold the elixir of devotion to Rama; may you ever remain the servant of Raghupati.
content.transliteration:
Aṣṭa siddhi nava nidhi ke dātā,
Asa bara dīna Jānakī Mātā.
Rāma rasāyana tumhare pāsā,
Sadā raho Raghupati ke dāsā.

content.shloka:
Tumhare bhajan Ram ko pavai,
Janam janam ke dukh bisravai.
Anta kaal Raghubar pur jai,
Jahan janam Hari-Bhakt kahai.
content.meaning: Through your worship, one attains Rama and forgets the sorrows of many lifetimes. At the end of life, one reaches the abode of Rama, and wherever one is born, one is known as a devotee of Hari.
content.transliteration:
Tumhare bhajana Rāma ko pāvai,
Janama janama ke dukha bisarāvai.
Anta kāla Raghubara pura jāī,
Jahān janama Hari-Bhakta kahāī.

content.shloka:
Aur devta chitt na dharai,
Hanumat sei sarb sukh karai.
Sankat katai mitai sab peera,
Jo sumirai Hanumat Balbeera.
content.meaning: Even if one does not worship any other deity, Hanuman alone bestows all happiness. All afflictions are removed and all pains vanish for those who remember the mighty Hanuman.
content.transliteration:
Aura devatā citta na dharaī,
Hanumata sei sarba sukha karaī.
Saṅkaṭa kaṭai miṭai saba pīrā,
Jo sumire Hanumata Balabīrā.

content.shloka:
Jai Jai Jai Hanuman Gosai,
Kripa karahu Gurudev ki nai.
Jo sat bar path kare koi,
Chhuthi bandhi maha sukh hoi.
content.meaning: Victory, victory, victory to Lord Hanuman! Bestow your grace upon me as my Guru. Whoever recites this a hundred times is freed from bondage and attains supreme bliss.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Hanumāna Gosāī,
Kṛpā karahu Gurudeva kī nāī.
Jo śata bāra pāṭha kare koī,
Chūṭahi bandhi mahā sukha hoī.

content.shloka:
Jo yah padhe Hanuman Chalisa,
Hoy siddhi sakhi Gaurisa.
Tulsidas sada Hari chera,
Keejai Nath hriday mah dera.
content.meaning: Whoever reads this Hanuman Chalisa attains spiritual fulfillment, as Lord Shiva is witness. Tulsidas, always a servant of Hari, prays: O Lord, make my heart your abode.
content.transliteration:
Jo yaha paḍhai Hanumāna Cālīsā,
Hoya siddhi sākhī Gaurīśā.
Tulasīdāsa sadā Hari cerā,
Kījai Nātha hṛdaya maha ḍerā.

content.shloka:
Pavan Tanay sankat haran, Mangal murati roop.
Ram Lakhan Sita sahit, Hriday basahu sur bhoop.
content.meaning: O son of the wind, remover of calamities, embodiment of auspiciousness, dwell in my heart along with Rama, Lakshmana, and Sita, O king among the gods.
content.transliteration:
Pavana Tanaya saṅkaṭa harana, Maṅgala mūrati rūpa.
Rāma Lakhana Sītā sahita, Hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa.

content.shloka:
Jai Ganpati Sadgun Sadan,
Kavivar Badan Kripaal.
Vighna Haran Mangal Karan,
Jai Jai Girijaalaal.
content.meaning: Victory to Ganapati, the abode of virtues, with a beautiful face and compassionate nature. Remover of obstacles and bestower of auspiciousness, victory to the son of Girija (Parvati).
content.transliteration:
Jaya Gaṇapati Sadguṇa Sadana,
Kavivara Badana Kṛpāla.
Vighna Haraṇa Maṅgala Karaṇa,
Jaya Jaya Girijālāla.

content.shloka:
Jai Jai Jai Ganpati Ganraju,
Mangal bharan karan shubh kaju.
Jai Gajbadan Sadan Sukhdaata,
Vishwa Vinaayak Buddhi Vidhaata.
content.meaning: Victory to Ganapati, the king of the ganas, who fills all auspicious tasks with blessings. Victory to the elephant-faced one, the bestower of happiness, the lord of the universe, and the giver of wisdom.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Jaya Jaya Gaṇapati Gaṇarāju,
Maṅgala bharaṇa karaṇa śubha kāju.
Jaya Gajabadana Sadana Sukhadātā,
Viśva Vināyaka Buddhi Vidhātā.

content.shloka:
Vakra Tund Shund Suviraajit,
Shobhit Sindur Tilak Samaajit.
Rakta Vasan Nav Nirmal Gaata,
Jhilmil Jhilmil Lochan Suhata.
content.meaning: Your curved trunk is magnificently adorned, decorated with a beautiful vermilion mark. You wear red garments on your divine body, and your twinkling eyes are enchanting.
content.transliteration:
Vakra Tuṇḍa Śuṇḍa Suvirājita,
Śobhita Sindūra Tilaka Samājita.
Rakta Vasana Nava Nirmala Gātā,
Jhilamila Jhilamila Locana Suhātā.

content.shloka:
Gaj Baini Bhaganhaari Suhaai,
Neelkamalbimal Nen Suhavani.
Kankan Kundal Uditaang Raajit,
Har Kesh Muktahaar Saajit.
content.meaning: Your elephant brow is beautiful and captivating, and your eyes are pure like blue lotuses. Bracelets and earrings shine on your radiant body, and your hair is adorned with a pearl necklace.
content.transliteration:
Gaja Bainī Bhaganaharī Suhāī,
Nīlakamala bimala Nena Suhāvanī.
Kaṅkana Kuṇḍala Uditāṅga Rājita,
Hāra Keśa Muktāhāra Sājita.

content.shloka:
Modak Priy Mudmangalkari,
Vidya Varidhi Buddhi Ujaari.
Maangat Tulasidas Kar Jore,
Basahu Hriday Kripaa Drishti More.
content.meaning: You love modak sweets and bestow joy and auspiciousness. You are the ocean of learning and the illuminator of intelligence. Tulsidas begs with folded hands: dwell in my heart and cast your gracious glance upon me.
content.transliteration:
Modaka Priya Mudamaṅgalakārī,
Vidyā Vāridhi Buddhi Ujārī.
Māṅgata Tulasīdāsa Kara Jore,
Basahu Hṛdaya Kṛpā Dṛṣṭi More.

content.shloka:
Sindhoor Laal Charchaavat Gaata,
Shubh Drishti Tumhari Man Bhaata.
Kar Mein Modak Loddoo Saaje,
Har Chhand Vilambito Suhavane Gaaje.
content.meaning: Your body is smeared with red vermilion, and your auspicious gaze captivates the mind. In your hands are decorated modaks and laddoos, and your beautiful melodies resound in every verse.
content.transliteration:
Sindūra Lāla Carcāvata Gātā,
Śubha Dṛṣṭi Tumhārī Mana Bhātā.
Kara Meṃ Modaka Loḍḍū Sāje,
Hara Chanda Vilambito Suhāvane Gāje.

content.shloka:
Bhaal Tilak Darshan Paripaavana,
Jo Nar Dhyaavat Moosha Vaahana.
Kaanan Kundal Jhilmil Taare,
Nayan Manohar Bhaav Nihaare.
content.meaning: The tilak on your forehead is sacred to behold, and blessed is the one who meditates on the rider of the mouse. Your earrings twinkle like stars, and your eyes behold all with beautiful emotion.
content.transliteration:
Bhāla Tilaka Darśana Paripāvana,
Jo Nara Dhyāvata Mūṣa Vāhana.
Kānana Kuṇḍala Jhilamila Tāre,
Nayana Manohara Bhāva Nihāre.

content.shloka:
Tanu Rajeev Tanman Dhan Daata,
Tum Samaan Nahin Koi Vikhyaata.
Shesh Mahesh Ganesh Gun Gaavat,
Saarad Shankar Vedh Bataavat.
content.meaning: Your body is radiant and you are the giver of mind, body, and wealth. There is none as famous as you. Shesha, Shiva, and all praise Ganesha's virtues, while Saraswati, Shankar, and the Vedas proclaim your glory.
content.transliteration:
Tanu Rājīva Tanamana Dhana Dātā,
Tuma Samāna Nahi Koī Vikhyātā.
Śeṣa Maheśa Gaṇeśa Guṇa Gāvata,
Śārada Śaṅkara Veda Batāvata.

content.shloka:
Aru Devtaa Nar Muni Jete,
Pahile Tum Ko Poojat Tete.
Aisa Yash Tum Jagat Maaheen,
Tum Samaan Prabhu Koi Naaheen.
content.meaning: All the gods, humans, and sages worship you first above all. Such is your glory in this world; there is no lord equal to you.
content.transliteration:
Aru Devatā Nara Muni Jete,
Pahile Tuma Ko Pūjata Tete.
Aisā Yaśa Tuma Jagata Māhī,
Tuma Samāna Prabhu Koī Nāhī.

content.shloka:
Neetal Feral Vimal Tanu Sohe,
Sab Jan Mann Maahen Moh Mohe.
Bhojan Priya Tundil Stuti Gaavat,
Prasann Hoy Jab Bhakt Bulaavat.
content.meaning: Your pure body shines with a blue hue and captivates the minds of all. You love food, and your large belly is praised in hymns; you are pleased when devotees call upon you.
content.transliteration:
Nīlala Pherala Vimala Tanu Sohe,
Saba Jana Mana Māheṃ Moha Mohe.
Bhojana Priya Tuṇḍila Stuti Gāvata,
Prasanna Hoya Jaba Bhakta Bulāvata.

content.shloka:
Chatur Viraajit Kripaanidhaan,
Santat Sundara Sada Sujaan.
Bahujan Hridaya Mein Deva Biraje,
Vishwa Karta Shir Mukut Saaje.
content.meaning: You are seated in splendor, the treasury of mercy, eternally beautiful and ever wise. In the hearts of all beings, this god resides, the creator of the universe, crowned with a majestic diadem.
content.transliteration:
Catura Virājita Kṛpānidhāna,
Santata Sundara Sadā Sujāna.
Bahujana Hṛdaya Meṃ Deva Birāje,
Viśva Kartā Śira Mukuṭa Sāje.

content.shloka:
Mushak Vaahan Mohe Mann Bhaavai,
Gatan Vighna Vighnahin Naashavai.
Vighn Vinaashan Mangal Kaari,
Kripaalu Kripa Karo Mahatari.
content.meaning: The mouse vehicle is pleasing to my heart. You clear the path and destroy all obstacles. O destroyer of obstacles and source of auspiciousness, O merciful one, bestow your grace, O great lord.
content.transliteration:
Mūṣaka Vāhana Mohe Mana Bhāvai,
Gatana Vighna Vighnahiṃ Nāśavai.
Vighna Vināśana Maṅgala Kārī,
Kṛpālu Kṛpā Karo Mahātārī.

content.shloka:
Tumhe Manaav Buddhi Ram Shabad,
Ash Ashtak Mangal Prasad.
Dhoopam Deepam Phal Bal Bhog,
Pranavat Hi Katai Sab Rog.
content.meaning: I worship you with intellect, the name of Rama, eight auspicious offerings, and sacred prasad. With incense, lamp, fruit, and food offerings, all diseases are dispelled by bowing to you.
content.transliteration:
Tumhe Manāva Buddhi Rāma Śabada,
Aṣṭa Aṣṭaka Maṅgala Prasāda.
Dhūpam Dīpam Phala Bala Bhoga,
Praṇavata Hī Kaṭai Saba Roga.

content.shloka:
Mangal Murti Marut Nandan,
Sakal Amangl Ko Khandn.
Bite Sab Jan Ke Sankat Bhaari,
Jo Sumire Shri Gauri Sut Vaari.
content.meaning: O auspicious one, son of the wind (another form), you destroy all inauspiciousness. The heavy troubles of all people are removed when they remember the beloved son of Gauri.
content.transliteration:
Maṅgala Mūrti Māruta Nandana,
Sakala Amaṅgala Ko Khaṇḍana.
Bīte Saba Jana Ke Saṅkaṭa Bhārī,
Jo Sumire Śrī Gaurī Suta Vārī.

content.shloka:
Siddhi Vinayak Khol Aadhar,
Sumirat Prabhu Jag Mangalkaar.
Trusthi Pusht Aru Maha Alankaar,
Giri Sur Nandan Manohar.
content.meaning: O Siddhi Vinayak, open the doors of support. Remembering the Lord brings auspiciousness to the world. You are adorned with satisfaction, nourishment, and magnificent ornaments, O delightful son of the mountain lord.
content.transliteration:
Siddhi Vināyaka Khola Ādhāra,
Sumirata Prabhu Jaga Maṅgalakāra.
Tuṣṭi Puṣṭi Aru Mahā Alaṅkāra,
Giri Sura Nandana Manohara.

content.shloka:
Maha Devsuvan Paarvatee Nandan,
Gatan Vighna Karan Aanandan.
Riddhi Siddhi Ke Kaaran Data,
Grih Saubhaagya Samriddhi Vidhaata.
content.meaning: O son of Mahadeva and Parvati, you remove obstacles and bestow bliss. You are the giver of Riddhi and Siddhi (prosperity and accomplishment), the creator of household fortune and abundance.
content.transliteration:
Mahā Devasuvana Pārvatī Nandana,
Gatana Vighna Karaṇa Ānandana.
Ṛddhi Siddhi Ke Kāraṇa Dātā,
Gṛha Saubhāgya Samṛddhi Vidhātā.

content.shloka:
Ek Dant Dayaavant Chari,
Karunadhaar Vimal Bichari.
Kahun Kitna Tav Gun Mahin,
Tum Samaan Daata Koi Nahin.
content.meaning: O one-tusked one, compassionate in nature, merciful and pure in thought. How much can I describe your virtues? There is no giver equal to you.
content.transliteration:
Eka Danta Dayāvanta Cārī,
Karuṇādhāra Vimala Bicārī.
Kahū Kitanā Tava Guṇa Māhī,
Tuma Samāna Dātā Koī Nāhī.

content.shloka:
Surpati Narpati Tap Nirantar,
Tapai Manav Sumanav Upar.
Kshudra Janam Jimi Vahe Bhavani,
Hoy Prasanna Teri Mriduvaani.
content.meaning: The king of gods and earthly kings perform penance continuously, and humans and celestials worship you. Even those of humble birth, O son of Bhavani, are uplifted when pleased by your gentle speech.
content.transliteration:
Surapati Narapati Tapa Nirantara,
Tapai Mānava Sumānava Upara.
Kṣudra Janma Jimi Vahe Bhavānī,
Hoya Prasanna Terī Mṛduvānī.

content.shloka:
Vighna Haran Mangal Daata Jan,
Krupaa Karahu Gurudev Samaan.
Chaalisa Ganaesh Jo Gaavai,
Nit Nav Mangalkaamna Paavai.
content.meaning: O remover of obstacles and giver of auspiciousness, bestow mercy upon me like a divine teacher. Whoever sings this Ganesh Chalisa receives ever-new auspicious blessings daily.
content.transliteration:
Vighna Haraṇa Maṅgala Dātā Jana,
Kṛpā Karahu Gurudeva Samāna.
Cālīsā Gaṇeśa Jo Gāvai,
Nita Nava Maṅgalakāmanā Pāvai.

content.shloka:
Kapat Vinashana Granthi Haari,
Mangal Karan Ati Bhayahaari.
Sab Sankat Ko Naashat Deena,
Jai Jag Kaaran Vighn Vihina.
content.meaning: You destroy deceit and untie all knots, bring auspiciousness and remove great fears. You destroy all troubles of the helpless. Victory to the cause of the world, free from all obstacles.
content.transliteration:
Kapaṭa Vināśana Granthi Hārī,
Maṅgala Karaṇa Ati Bhayahārī.
Saba Saṅkaṭa Ko Nāśata Dīnā,
Jaya Jaga Kāraṇa Vighna Vihīnā.

content.shloka:
Sumire Ganapati Mann Mein Dhyana,
Purn Hove Sab Manorath Jaana.
Jai Jai Jai Shri Ganesh Vinayak,
Karahu Kripa Rakho Jan Nayak.
content.meaning: Meditate on Ganapati in your mind, and know that all your desires shall be fulfilled. Victory, victory, victory to Shri Ganesh Vinayak! Bestow your mercy and protect your devotees, O leader.
content.transliteration:
Sumire Gaṇapati Mana Meṃ Dhyāna,
Pūrṇa Hove Saba Manoratha Jānā.
Jaya Jaya Jaya Śrī Gaṇeśa Vināyaka,
Karahu Kṛpā Rākho Jana Nāyaka.

content.shloka:
Namo Namo Durge Sukh Karani,
Namo Namo Ambe Dukh Harani.
content.meaning: Salutations to you, O Durga, the bestower of happiness. Salutations to you, O Amba, the remover of sorrows.
content.transliteration:
Namo Namo Durge Sukha Karaṇī,
Namo Namo Ambe Dukha Haraṇī.

content.shloka:
Nirakar hai jyoti tumhari,
Tihun lok phaili ujiyaari.
Sasht roop mein tum hi puri,
Maheshwari hai deva sundari.
content.meaning: Formless is your divine light, spreading its radiance across the three worlds. You pervade the entire creation in your form; you are Maheshwari, the beautiful goddess among gods.
content.transliteration:
Nirākāra hai jyoti tumhārī,
Tihun loka phailī ujiyārī.
Saśṭha rūpa meṃ tumhī purī,
Maheśvarī hai deva sundarī.

content.shloka:
Sev tumhaari kara deva dhuvahi,
Bidhi Hari Rudra shakti binu paavahi.
Pratham shaila sut roop banaya,
Nag lok mein tum hi samaaya.
content.meaning: The gods always worship you with devotion. Even Brahma, Vishnu, and Shiva cannot accomplish anything without your power. First you took the form of the daughter of the mountain, then you pervaded the serpent world.
content.transliteration:
Seva tumhārī kara deva dhuvahi,
Bidhi Hari Rudra śakti binu pāvahi.
Prathama Śailasuta rūpa banāyā,
Nāga loka meṃ tumhī samāyā.

content.shloka:
Doosra roop Brahmacharini,
Tap kar khor mahaadevaa cheeni.
Teesar Chandraghantaa chabharani,
Chauthi Kushmaandaa shakti dhaarani.
content.meaning: Your second form is Brahmacharini, who won Mahadeva through severe penance. The third is Chandraghanta with her beautiful bell, and the fourth is Kushmanda who holds the power of creation.
content.transliteration:
Dūsarā rūpa Brahmacāriṇī,
Tapa kara khoṭa Mahādevā cīnhī.
Tīsarā Candraghaṇṭā chabhāraṇī,
Cauthī Kūṣmāṇḍā śakti dhāraṇī.

content.shloka:
Paanchve Skanda Mata jab bhayi,
Shashtham Katyayani ati soi.
Saatve Kaalraatri maha maaya,
Aathva Maha Gauri gun gaaya.
content.meaning: In the fifth form you became Skanda Mata, and the sixth is Katyayani of great glory. The seventh is Kalratri, the great illusion, and the eighth is Maha Gauri whose virtues are sung.
content.transliteration:
Pāñcaveṃ Skanda Mātā jaba bhaī,
Ṣaṣṭhama Kātyāyanī ati soī.
Sātvīṃ Kālarātri mahā māyā,
Āṭhavā Mahā Gaurī guṇa gāyā.

content.shloka:
Nauvee Siddhidaatri jag jaani,
Shiv saṅg tumne paaya maani.
Tumne Madhu Kaitabh maare,
Sunbh Nisunbh bhi sanhare.
content.meaning: The ninth is Siddhidatri, known to the world. With Shiva, you received honor. You slew the demons Madhu and Kaitabha, and also destroyed Shumbha and Nishumbha.
content.transliteration:
Nauvīṃ Siddhidātrī jaga jānī,
Śiva saṅga tumne pāyā mānī.
Tumne Madhu Kaiṭabha māre,
Śumbha Niśumbha bhi saṃhāre.

content.shloka:
Mahishaasur nrip ati abhimaani,
Jehi agha bhar mahi akul-raani.
Tin kee traas dasha dis chhaai,
Devaan sab mil tumhi bulaayi.
content.meaning: The demon king Mahishasura was extremely arrogant, whose sins made the earth restless. His terror spread in all ten directions, and all the gods together called upon you.
content.transliteration:
Mahiṣāsura nṛpa ati abhimānī,
Jehi agha bhara mahi akula-rānī.
Tina kī trāsa daśa disa chāī,
Devān saba mili tumhi bulāī.

content.shloka:
Tab Durga tum ne avtaara,
Mahishaasur ko keenha sanhaar.
Tab deva sab sukhi bhaaye,
Shraddhaa se tumhin gun gaaye.
content.meaning: Then you incarnated as Durga and destroyed Mahishasura. All the gods became joyful and sang your praises with devotion.
content.transliteration:
Taba Durgā tuma ne avatāra,
Mahiṣāsura ko kīnha saṃhāra.
Taba deva saba sukhī bhāye,
Śraddhā se tumhiṃ guṇa gāye.

content.shloka:
Tum hi Lakshmi tum hi Sarasvati,
Tumhi prabhaavat devi avadhati.
Tumhi paatalaa Shivaa Subhakaari,
Tumhi shaantaa tum hi raagini pyaari.
content.meaning: You are Lakshmi, you are Saraswati, you are the powerful goddess of all. You are Patala and Shiva, the bestower of good fortune. You are Shanta and you are the beloved Ragini.
content.transliteration:
Tumhī Lakṣmī tumhī Sarasvatī,
Tumhī prabhāvata devī avadhātī.
Tumhī Pātālā Śivā Subhakārī,
Tumhī Śāntā tum hī rāginī pyārī.

content.shloka:
Chausath yogini mangal daata,
Shakti tumhi Shiv ki saangaata.
Panchami tum hi maai sarasvati,
Tumhi Savitri tum Sati suvirati.
content.meaning: You are the sixty-four yoginis, bestowing auspiciousness. You are the Shakti, the consort of Shiva. On the fifth day you are worshipped as Mother Saraswati. You are Savitri and you are Sati, the virtuous one.
content.transliteration:
Cauṣaṣṭi Yoginī Maṅgala Dātā,
Śakti tumhī Śiva kī sāṅgātā.
Pañcamī tumhī māī Sarasvatī,
Tumhī Sāvitrī tuma Satī suvratī.

content.shloka:
Rohini tum hi Rajani Ramaani,
Tumhi Trijata tum hi Tripuraani.
Tumhi Kaamdhenu Tum Gayatri,
Nimada Punyasalilaa Sarayu Matri.
content.meaning: You are Rohini, Rajani, and Ramani. You are Trijata and Tripurari. You are Kamdhenu and Gayatri. You are the sacred rivers Narmada, Punya Salila, and Mother Sarayu.
content.transliteration:
Rohinī tumhī Rajanī Ramāṇī,
Tumhī Trijaṭā tumhī Tripurāṇī.
Tumhī Kāmadhenū Tuma Gāyatrī,
Narmadā Puṇyasalilā Sarayū Mātrī.

content.shloka:
Tumhi Tulsi tum hi Vrinda pyari,
Tumhee Karuna Roop Khapparawaari.
Sab Dev tumhaare ageh aayen,
Sab ki bidhi tumse banaaye.
content.meaning: You are Tulsi and the beloved Vrinda. You are the compassionate one who wears the skull garland. All the gods come before you, and all affairs are resolved through you.
content.transliteration:
Tumhī Tulasī tumhī Vṛndā pyārī,
Tumhī Karuṇā Rūpa Khapparavārī.
Saba Deva tumhāre agaha āyeṃ,
Saba kī bidhi tumse banāye.

content.shloka:
Bhaktan ki rakhvaali tum hi,
Sukhdata dukh nivaari tum hi.
Sharanaagatat hai kripaa nidhaana,
Karahu kripa gurudev samaan.
content.meaning: You are the protector of devotees, the giver of happiness and the remover of sorrows. You are the treasure of mercy for those who seek your refuge. Bestow mercy like a divine teacher.
content.transliteration:
Bhaktana kī rakhavālī tumhī,
Sukhadātā dukha nivārī tumhī.
Śaraṇāgatata hai kṛpā nidhāna,
Karahu kṛpā Gurudeva samāna.

content.shloka:
Karahu kripa bahu din se dhara,
Manorathan ko pooran kara.
Bandee prem se Maa ko gaavai,
Mangal hi mangal sukh paavai.
content.meaning: Bestow your grace that has been awaited for so long, and fulfill my heart's desires. Whoever sings praises to the Mother with love receives auspiciousness upon auspiciousness and happiness.
content.transliteration:
Karahu kṛpā bahu dina se dharā,
Manorathana ko pūraṇa karā.
Bandī prema se Mā ko gāvai,
Maṅgala hī maṅgala sukha pāvai.

content.shloka:
Tera mandir tera dwar,
Mein aayaa teri sharan.
Dayaadrishti jo tum karo,
Kabhi na aavai haran.
content.meaning: Your temple, your door -- I have come to your shelter. If you cast your merciful glance, sorrow shall never come.
content.transliteration:
Terā mandira terā dvāra,
Maiṃ āyā terī śaraṇa.
Dayādṛṣṭi jo tuma karo,
Kabhī na āvai haraṇa.

content.shloka:
Nahin chhodun tera dwar Rani,
Jab lag kripa na hoy.
Kahun Kavan sharan tihare,
Jag mein tum bin koi.
content.meaning: I shall not leave your door, O Queen, until your grace descends. Tell me, whom else can I seek refuge in? There is none but you in this world.
content.transliteration:
Nahiṃ choḍūṃ terā dvāra Rānī,
Jaba laga kṛpā na hoya.
Kahūṃ kavana śaraṇa tihāre,
Jaga meṃ tuma bina koī.

content.shloka:
Devi sharanaagatat tihare,
Kripaa nidhi ab darash dikhavahu.
Mahima apar tumhari jaani,
Har lok mein ujiyaara thani.
content.meaning: O Goddess, I am at your refuge. O treasury of mercy, now reveal yourself. Your infinite glory is known -- in every realm your radiance shines bright.
content.transliteration:
Devī śaraṇāgatata tihāre,
Kṛpā nidhi aba darśa dikhāvahu.
Mahimā apāra tumhārī jānī,
Hara loka meṃ ujiyārā thānī.

content.shloka:
Durga Chalisa jo gaavai,
Sab sukh mangal paavai.
Devee daas Maalaa karai,
Sab vighna vinash sahai.
content.meaning: Whoever sings the Durga Chalisa receives all happiness and auspiciousness. Whoever serves the Goddess with a garland of devotion finds all obstacles destroyed.
content.transliteration:
Durgā Cālīsā jo gāvai,
Saba sukha maṅgala pāvai.
Devī dāsa mālā karai,
Saba vighna vināśa sahai.

content.shloka:
Jai Girijaa Pati Dinadayaala,
Sadaa Karat Santan Pratipala.
Bhaal Chandramaa Sohat Nike,
Kanan Kundal Naagaphan Ke.
content.meaning: Victory to the Lord of Girija (Parvati), the compassionate to the humble. He always protects the saints. The crescent moon adorns his forehead beautifully, and serpent hoods serve as his earrings.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Girijā Pati Dīnadayālā,
Sadā Karata Santana Pratipālā.
Bhāla Candramā Sohata Nīke,
Kānana Kuṇḍala Nāgaphana Ke.

content.shloka:
Ang Gaur Shir Gangaa Bahai,
Mundamaal Tan Chaar Lagaahi.
Vastra Khaal Baghambar Sohe,
Chavi Ko Dekh Naag Muni Mohe.
content.meaning: His body is fair, the Ganga flows from his head, a garland of skulls adorns his body with ashes. He wears a tiger skin which looks magnificent; seeing his splendor, even serpents and sages are enchanted.
content.transliteration:
Aṅga Gaura Śira Gaṅgā Bahāī,
Muṇḍamāla Tana Chāra Lagāhī.
Vastra Khāla Baghambara Sohe,
Chavi Ko Dekha Nāga Muni Mohe.

content.shloka:
Maina Maatu Ki Hava Dulari,
Vaam Ang Sohat Chhabi Nyaari.
Kar Trishul Sohat Chhabi Bhaari,
Karat Sadaa Shatrun Kshayakaari.
content.meaning: Maina's beloved daughter (Parvati) adorns his left side with a unique beauty. The trident in his hand has great magnificence, and he always destroys the enemies.
content.transliteration:
Mainā Mātu Kī Havā Dulārī,
Vāma Aṅga Sohata Chabi Nyārī.
Kara Triśūla Sohata Chabi Bhārī,
Karata Sadā Śatruna Kṣayakārī.

content.shloka:
Nandi Ganesh Sohain Tahan Kaise,
Sagar Madhya Kamal Hain Jaise.
Kartik Shyaam Aur Ganrau,
Yaa Chavi Ko Kahi Jaye Na Kau.
content.meaning: Nandi and Ganesha sit beside him like lotuses in the ocean. Kartikeya, Krishna, and Ganapati are there -- this splendor cannot be described by anyone.
content.transliteration:
Nandī Gaṇeśa Sohaiṃ Tahāṃ Kaise,
Sāgara Madhya Kamala Haiṃ Jaise.
Kārtika Śyāma Aura Gaṇarāu,
Yā Chavi Ko Kahi Jāye Na Kau.

content.shloka:
Devana Jabi Jab Tak Paayee,
Pujan Archan Thahan Chali Aayee.
Tab Prabhu Teen Lok Se Aaye,
Kailash Chalisa Gun Gaaye.
content.meaning: Whenever the gods receive any difficulty, they come there to worship and pray. Then the Lord who comes from the three worlds hears the Kailash Chalisa with its virtues sung.
content.transliteration:
Devana Jabī Jaba Taka Pāyī,
Pūjana Arcana Tahāṃ Calī Āyī.
Taba Prabhu Tīna Loka Se Āye,
Kailāśa Cālīsā Guṇa Gāye.

content.shloka:
Prabhu Bholenath ke gun gaavai,
Patan se katai sukh paavai.
Chaar Yug Partaap Tumhara,
Hai Parsiddh Jagat Ujiyaara.
content.meaning: Whoever sings the praises of Lord Bholenath is saved from downfall and gains happiness. Your glory extends through all four ages and is famous as the light of the world.
content.transliteration:
Prabhu Bholenātha ke guṇa gāvai,
Patana se kaṭai sukha pāvai.
Cāra Yuga Paratāpa Tumhārā,
Hai Parasiddha Jagata Ujiyārā.

content.shloka:
Dhyaan Tumhaara Jo Nar Dhyaavai,
Sadaa Sukhee Soi Jan Paavai.
Ashta Siddhi Nav Nidhi Ke Daata,
As Varadaan Deen Kripa Jaata.
content.meaning: Whoever meditates upon you always finds happiness. You are the bestower of the eight supernatural powers and nine treasures, granting such boons from your mercy.
content.transliteration:
Dhyāna Tumhārā Jo Nara Dhyāvai,
Sadā Sukhī Soī Jana Pāvai.
Aṣṭa Siddhi Nava Nidhi Ke Dātā,
Asa Varadāna Dīna Kṛpā Jātā.

content.shloka:
Jataadhaari Karunaanidhi Shankar,
Har Har Shankar Namaskar.
Jo Nar Shankar Ko Dhyaavai,
Sab Dukh Paap Taapon Ko Haravai.
content.meaning: O matted-haired one, ocean of compassion, Shankar. Hail to you, Shankar, salutations. Whoever meditates upon Shankar is freed from all sorrow, sin, and suffering.
content.transliteration:
Jaṭādhārī Karuṇānidhī Śaṅkara,
Hara Hara Śaṅkara Namaskāra.
Jo Nara Śaṅkara Ko Dhyāvai,
Saba Dukha Pāpa Tāpona Ko Haravai.

content.shloka:
He Maheshwar Prabhu Bholedaani,
Jan Pat Par Karo Kalyaani.
Surahi Dhenu Sab Kamana Puran,
Yah Var Maangi Gaye Charan.
content.meaning: O Maheshwar, Lord Bholedani, bring welfare to your fallen devotees. Like the wish-fulfilling cow granting all desires, I beg this boon at your feet.
content.transliteration:
He Maheśvara Prabhu Bholedānī,
Jana Pata Para Karo Kalyāṇī.
Surabhī Dhenu Saba Kāmanā Pūraṇa,
Yaha Vara Māṅgī Gaye Caraṇa.

content.shloka:
Yah Sansar Rogi Khinatara,
Liye Aoushadhi Jab Shankar.
Sab Dev Asur Jab Ghut Aayi,
Neelkanth Tab Naam Kahaai.
content.meaning: When this world was suffering like a patient, Shankar took the medicine (poison). When all gods and demons were in distress, he drank the poison and was called Neelkanth (the blue-throated one).
content.transliteration:
Yaha Saṃsāra Rogī Khinatarā,
Liye Auṣadhī Jaba Śaṅkara.
Saba Deva Asura Jaba Ghuṭa Āyī,
Nīlakaṇṭha Taba Nāma Kahāī.

content.shloka:
Pujan Ramchandra Jab Keenha,
Jeet Ke Lanka Ko Vibhishan Deenha.
Sahas Kamal Mein Ho Rahe Dhaari,
Keenha Pariksha Tabahi Puraari.
content.meaning: When Ramchandra performed your worship, he conquered Lanka and gave it to Vibhishana. When one lotus was missing from the thousand offered, the Lord of Tripura tested him.
content.transliteration:
Pūjana Rāmacandra Jaba Kīnhā,
Jīta Ke Laṅkā Ko Vibhīṣaṇa Dīnhā.
Sahasa Kamala Meṃ Ho Rahe Dhārī,
Kīnha Parīkṣā Tabahi Purārī.

content.shloka:
Ek Kamal Prabhu Raakheu Joi,
Kushal-Kshem Sab Raahi Soi.
Jab Lagi Srishti Rahe Sansar,
Tab Lagi Rahai Shiv Avataar.
content.meaning: The Lord preserved that one lotus, and all remained well and safe. As long as creation and the world exist, Shiva's incarnation shall endure.
content.transliteration:
Eka Kamala Prabhu Rākheu Joī,
Kuśala-Kṣema Saba Rāhī Soī.
Jaba Lagi Sṛṣṭi Rahe Saṃsāra,
Taba Lagi Rahai Śiva Avatāra.

content.shloka:
Apni Kripa Ka Karo Vichaar,
Bachcho Ko Sabhi Sansaar.
Jhut Hi Jhut Jagat Pasaara,
Niragun Sargun Roop Tumhara.
content.meaning: Consider showing your grace and save all the children of the world. This worldly expanse is all illusion; both formless and with form is your nature.
content.transliteration:
Apanī Kṛpā Kā Karo Vicāra,
Baccho Ko Sabhī Saṃsāra.
Jhūṭa Hī Jhūṭa Jagata Pasārā,
Nirguṇa Sarguṇa Rūpa Tumhārā.

content.shloka:
Sarv Shrishti Tumhaari Pashaari,
Tumhi Paalak Sanhaari Bhaari.
Devana Kee Sadaa Pratipala,
Karo Kripa Dinadayaala.
content.meaning: All creation is your expanse; you are the great sustainer and destroyer. You always protect the gods; bestow your mercy, O compassionate to the humble.
content.transliteration:
Sarva Sṛṣṭi Tumhārī Paśārī,
Tumhī Pālaka Saṃhārī Bhārī.
Devana Kī Sadā Pratipālā,
Karo Kṛpā Dīnadayālā.

content.shloka:
Tripuraari Triloki Man Raaja,
Hain Tumhaare Sab Lok Samaaja.
Dhyaan Dharein Jo Jan Man Laaye,
Sab Manovaanchit Phal Paaye.
content.meaning: O destroyer of the three cities, you reign in the hearts of the three worlds. All realms and societies are yours. Whoever focuses their mind in meditation upon you attains all desired fruits.
content.transliteration:
Tripurārī Trilokī Mana Rājā,
Haiṃ Tumhāre Saba Loka Samājā.
Dhyāna Dharaiṃ Jo Jana Mana Lāye,
Saba Manovāñchita Phala Pāye.

content.shloka:
Shiv Chaaleesaa Jo Nit Gaavai,
Sab Sukh Aishwarya Samridhi Paavai.
Rogee Ho Ya Santaap Jahaa,
Suniye Shiv Chalisa Yahaa.
content.meaning: Whoever sings the Shiv Chalisa daily attains all happiness, prosperity, and abundance. Whether there is sickness or suffering, listen to the Shiv Chalisa here.
content.transliteration:
Śiva Cālīsā Jo Nita Gāvai,
Saba Sukha Aiśvarya Samṛddhi Pāvai.
Rogī Ho Yā Santāpa Jahā,
Suniye Śiva Cālīsā Yahāṃ.

content.shloka:
Om Namah Shivaay Dhun Lagaaye,
Sab Dukh Daaridrya Paap Nashaaye.
Har Har Mahadev Shankar Naam,
Japat Sadaa Purna Hoi Kaam.
content.meaning: By chanting the mantra Om Namah Shivaya, all sorrow, poverty, and sin are destroyed. By always chanting Har Har Mahadev Shankar's name, all tasks are accomplished.
content.transliteration:
Om Namaḥ Śivāya Dhuna Lagāye,
Saba Dukha Dāridrya Pāpa Naśāye.
Hara Hara Mahādeva Śaṅkara Nāma,
Japata Sadā Pūrṇa Hoī Kāma.

content.shloka:
Shri Ramchandra Kripalu Bhajaman,
Haran Bhav Bhay Daarunam.
Nav Kanj Lochan Kanj Mukh,
Kar Kanj Pad Kanjarunam.
content.meaning: Worship the merciful Lord Rama in your heart, who removes the terrible fears of worldly existence. His eyes are like fresh lotuses, his face like a lotus, his hands like lotuses, and his lotus feet bestow compassion.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Rāmacandra Kṛpālu Bhajamana,
Haraṇa Bhava Bhaya Dāruṇam.
Nava Kañja Locana Kañja Mukha,
Kara Kañja Pada Kañjāruṇam.

content.shloka:
Jai Ram Sada Sukhdham,
Ram Gun Dham Vishram.
Sharanaagatat Paalak Raam,
Bhav Dukh Harak Pranaam.
content.meaning: Victory to Rama, the eternal abode of happiness. Rama is the abode of virtues and the place of rest. Rama is the protector of those who take refuge, and I bow to the one who removes worldly sorrows.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Rāma Sadā Sukhadhāma,
Rāma Guṇa Dhāma Viśrāma.
Śaraṇāgatata Pālaka Rāma,
Bhava Dukha Haraka Praṇāma.

content.shloka:
Shri Ram Jai Ram Jai Jai Ram,
Tanmay Bhaye Dekh Lalaam.
Janma Deen Bhayahu Hari,
Kaushalya Maatu Ke Dhaam.
content.meaning: Shri Ram, Victory to Ram, Victory Victory to Ram. All became enraptured seeing the divine beauty. The Lord took birth in the home of Mother Kaushalya, bestowing joy.
content.transliteration:
Śrī Rāma Jaya Rāma Jaya Jaya Rāma,
Tanmaya Bhaye Dekha Lalāma.
Janma Dīna Bhayahu Hari,
Kausalyā Mātu Ke Dhāma.

content.shloka:
Kaushalya Mata Putra Pyare,
Dashrath Ke Pran Nirmale.
Muni Vishvamitra Ke Sang Chale,
Maar Subahu Taadka Bhale.
content.meaning: Dear son of Mother Kaushalya, the pure life-breath of Dasharatha. He went with sage Vishwamitra and valiantly slew Subahu and Tadaka.
content.transliteration:
Kausalyā Mātā Putra Pyāre,
Daśaratha Ke Prāṇa Nirmale.
Muni Viśvāmitra Ke Saṅga Cale,
Māra Subāhu Tāḍakā Bhale.

content.shloka:
Dhanush yagya mein dhanush uthaya,
Janakpur mein jash chhaya.
Sita sang biyaah rachaya,
Anand mangal chhaya.
content.meaning: At the bow sacrifice, he lifted the bow and his glory spread throughout Janakpur. He married Sita, and joy and auspiciousness prevailed everywhere.
content.transliteration:
Dhanuṣa yajña meṃ dhanuṣa uṭhāyā,
Janakapura meṃ yaśa chāyā.
Sītā saṅga biyāha racāyā,
Ānanda maṅgala chāyā.

content.shloka:
Pita bachan par van sidhare,
Lakshman Sita sang pyaare.
Chitrakoot mein baas kiya,
Bhil bheelni ko taar diya.
content.meaning: Following his father's command, he departed for the forest with beloved Lakshmana and Sita. He resided at Chitrakoot and liberated the tribal woman Shabari.
content.transliteration:
Pitā bacana para vana sidhāre,
Lakṣmaṇa Sītā saṅga pyāre.
Citrakūṭa meṃ bāsa kiyā,
Bhīla Bhīlanī ko tāra diyā.

content.shloka:
Dandak van mein kiye vichar,
Rishi muniyana ke dukh nivaar.
Maarich mrig roop banaya,
Sita harana ka saaj sajaya.
content.meaning: In the Dandaka forest he traveled with purpose, removing the sorrows of sages and ascetics. Maricha took the form of a golden deer, setting the stage for Sita's abduction.
content.transliteration:
Daṇḍaka vana meṃ kiye vicāra,
Ṛṣi muniyāna ke dukha nivāra.
Mārīca mṛga rūpa banāyā,
Sītā haraṇa kā sāja sajāyā.

content.shloka:
Lanka par chadi kar chale,
Sita Mata ki khoj bhale.
Hanuman sang preet lagaai,
Sugriva se maitri badhaai.
content.meaning: He marched onward toward Lanka, searching nobly for Mother Sita. He established love with Hanuman and strengthened friendship with Sugriva.
content.transliteration:
Laṅkā para caḍhi kara cale,
Sītā Mātā kī khoja bhale.
Hanumāna saṅga prīta lagāī,
Sugrīva se maitrī baḍhāī.

content.shloka:
Baali badh kar dhar dharma,
Samudra bandh maha karma.
Lanka jeet Raavan sanhaara,
Sita sahit kiye ghar dwaar.
content.meaning: He established dharma by slaying Bali, and his great feat was building a bridge across the ocean. He conquered Lanka and destroyed Ravana, returning home with Sita.
content.transliteration:
Bālī badha kara dhara dharma,
Samudra bandha mahā karma.
Laṅkā jīta Rāvaṇa saṃhāra,
Sītā sahita kiye ghara dvāra.

content.shloka:
Ayodhya mein aaye Shri Raam,
Bhaye prafullit sab ke kaam.
Raj tilak dharyo tab maatha,
Anand bhayo sab ke saath.
content.meaning: Shri Rama returned to Ayodhya, and everyone's desires were fulfilled with joy. The coronation tilak was placed on his forehead, and there was bliss for all.
content.transliteration:
Ayodhyā meṃ āye Śrī Rāma,
Bhaye praphullita saba ke kāma.
Rāja tilaka dharayo taba māthā,
Ānanda bhayo saba ke sātha.

content.shloka:
Ram rajya tab bhayo sukhkari,
Praja priy dharma aadhaari.
Nahin rog na shok paaye,
Sab jan sukh sampat aaye.
content.meaning: Then Ram Rajya (the reign of Rama) brought happiness to all. The people loved the rule based on dharma. There was no disease or sorrow; all people received happiness and prosperity.
content.transliteration:
Rāma rājya taba bhayo sukhakārī,
Prajā priya dharma ādhārī.
Nāhiṃ roga na śoka pāye,
Saba jana sukha sampata āye.

content.shloka:
Raghubar chhaavi adbhut dhari,
Jag mein shobha ati bhari.
Koti Manmath lajjaavani,
Shobha sheel guna khaani.
content.meaning: Raghubar (Rama) manifested wondrous splendor, filling the world with unmatched beauty. His beauty shames millions of Kamadevas; he is a mine of beauty, virtue, and good character.
content.transliteration:
Raghubara chāvī adbhuta dharī,
Jaga meṃ śobhā ati bharī.
Koṭi Manamatha lajjāvanī,
Śobhā śīla guṇa khānī.

content.shloka:
Prabhu tumhaar charan ki sevaa,
Sadaa karai nar jeevan devaa.
Sab manorath pooran hovai,
Dukh daaridrya nikat nahin aavai.
content.meaning: He who always serves your lotus feet, O Lord, receives the gift of life. All desires are fulfilled, and sorrow and poverty never come near.
content.transliteration:
Prabhu tumhāra caraṇa kī sevā,
Sadā karai nara jīvana devā.
Saba manoratha pūraṇa hovai,
Dukha dāridrya nikaṭa nahiṃ āvai.

content.shloka:
Kahat Raam hi Raam sanehi,
Tin nar kari upkaar yehi.
Ram Naam binu nar jag maahi,
Dukh paavat kachhu sukh naahi.
content.meaning: Those who lovingly chant Rama's name bestow great benefit on themselves. Without Rama's name, people in this world receive only sorrow and no happiness.
content.transliteration:
Kahata Rāma hī Rāma sanehī,
Tina nara kari upakāra yehī.
Rāma Nāma binu nara jaga māhī,
Dukha pāvata kachu sukha nāhī.

content.shloka:
Ram Charitra suniye man laaye,
Sab paap taap sankat mit jaaye.
Sunderkand kahat jo koi,
Bandhan mukt sadaa sukh hoi.
content.meaning: Listen to the story of Rama with an attentive mind, and all sins, suffering, and troubles are destroyed. Whoever recites the Sunderkand is freed from bondage and always finds happiness.
content.transliteration:
Rāma Caritra suniye mana lāye,
Saba pāpa tāpa saṅkaṭa miṭa jāye.
Sundarakāṇḍa kahata jo koī,
Bandhana mukta sadā sukha hoī.

content.shloka:
Mangal bhavan amangal haari,
Dravahu so Dashrath Ajir Bihaari.
Ram Naam nij sarv sahaayi,
Japiye nit anand man bhaayi.
content.meaning: The abode of auspiciousness and remover of inauspiciousness, be gracious O one who plays in Dasharatha's courtyard. Rama's name is everyone's own helper; chant it daily with joy in your heart.
content.transliteration:
Maṅgala bhavana amaṅgala hārī,
Dravahu so Daśaratha Ajira Bihārī.
Rāma Nāma nija sarva sahāyī,
Japiye nita ānanda mana bhāyī.

content.shloka:
Ram Chalisa jo nit path kare,
Sab bidhi sukh sampati ghar bhare.
Sankat kate mite sab peera,
Japiye nirantar Ram nam dheeraa.
content.meaning: Whoever recites the Ram Chalisa daily fills their home with all kinds of happiness and wealth. All afflictions are cut away and all pains vanish; chant Rama's name steadily and constantly.
content.transliteration:
Rāma Cālīsā jo nita paṭha kare,
Saba bidhi sukha sampati ghara bhare.
Saṅkaṭa kaṭe miṭe saba pīrā,
Japiye nirantara Rāma nāma dhīrā.

content.shloka:
Jai Shri Krishna Hare Prabhu,
Deen Dayaal Govind.
Jag Kaaran Karan Kripaa Nidhi,
Vishwa Vihari Mukund.
content.meaning: Victory to Shri Krishna, Lord Hari, the compassionate Govinda. O treasury of mercy, the cause of the world, O Mukunda who plays in the universe.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Hare Prabhu,
Dīna Dayāla Govinda.
Jaga Kāraṇa Karaṇa Kṛpā Nidhi,
Viśva Vihārī Mukunda.

content.shloka:
Jai Yadunandan Jai Jagannath,
Kripadrishti karo deen ke nath.
Jai Devaki Nandan Jai Kanha,
Jai Gopi Gwal Priya Mana.
content.meaning: Victory to the son of the Yadu clan, victory to the Lord of the universe. Cast your merciful glance, O Lord of the humble. Victory to the son of Devaki, victory to Kanha, beloved of the Gopis and cowherds.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Yadunandana Jaya Jagannātha,
Kṛpādṛṣṭi karo dīna ke nātha.
Jaya Devakī Nandana Jaya Kānhā,
Jaya Gopī Gvāla Priya Manā.

content.shloka:
Hathi Ghati Ooch Neech Jahan,
Tum Bin Sab Sunhaan.
Karan Dharan Jag Mein Prabhu,
Sab Hi Tumhaar Vidhan.
content.meaning: In hills and valleys, high and low places -- without you, all is desolate. The doing and sustaining in this world, O Lord, is all your design.
content.transliteration:
Hāṭhī Ghāṭī Ūca Nīca Jahāṃ,
Tuma Bina Saba Sunhāna.
Karaṇa Dharaṇa Jaga Meṃ Prabhu,
Saba Hī Tumhāra Vidhāna.

content.shloka:
Devaki Nandan Nand Gopal,
Yashoda Nandan Brij Ke Lal.
Gokul Mein Aanand Bhadhaayo,
Maiya Yashoda Ko Sukh Dhaayo.
content.meaning: Son of Devaki, Nanda's Gopal, Yashoda's son, the darling of Vraja. You spread bliss in Gokul and brought happiness to Mother Yashoda.
content.transliteration:
Devakī Nandana Nanda Gopāla,
Yaśodā Nandana Braja Ke Lāla.
Gokula Meṃ Ānanda Baḍhāyo,
Maiyā Yaśodā Ko Sukha Dhāyo.

content.shloka:
Putna Aayi Jab Doodh Pilaaye,
Krishna Ne Uska Praan Ganvaaye.
Trinavart Asur Sanhaara,
Shakatasur Ka Kiya Bichaara.
content.meaning: When Putana came to nurse you with poison, Krishna took her life. You destroyed the demon Trinavarta and finished the demon Shakatasura.
content.transliteration:
Pūtanā Āyī Jaba Dūdha Pilāye,
Kṛṣṇa Ne Usakā Prāṇa Gaṃvāye.
Tṛṇāvarta Asura Saṃhāra,
Śakaṭāsura Kā Kiyā Bicārā.

content.shloka:
Maakhan Chori Karat Nandlal,
Nit Nav Leela Karain Gopal.
Gwalin Sang Raas Rachaaya,
Brij Mein Aanand Badhaya.
content.meaning: Nandlal steals butter in his daily play, and Gopal performs ever-new divine sports. He danced the Raas with the Gopis and increased the bliss in Vraja.
content.transliteration:
Mākhana Corī Karata Nandalāla,
Nita Nava Līlā Karaiṃ Gopāla.
Gvālina Saṅga Rāsa Racāyā,
Braja Meṃ Ānanda Baḍhāyā.

content.shloka:
Kaaliya Naag Ka Maan Bhanjaa,
Naag Nathiya Par Nritya Rachaya.
Govardhan Parvat Uthaya,
Brij Vasiyon Ki Raksha Karaya.
content.meaning: You crushed the pride of the serpent Kaliya and danced upon his hooded head. You lifted Mount Govardhan and protected the people of Vraja.
content.transliteration:
Kāliya Nāga Kā Māna Bhañjā,
Nāga Nāthiyā Para Nṛtya Racāyā.
Govardhana Parvata Uṭhāyā,
Braja Vāsiyoṃ Kī Rakṣā Karāyā.

content.shloka:
Kans Vadh Kiya Mathura Jaai,
Mata Pita Ko Bandhan Se Chudaai.
Ugrasena Ko Rajya Dilaaya,
Praja Sukhi Kar Anand Bhaya.
content.meaning: Going to Mathura, you slew Kansa and freed your parents from bondage. You restored the kingdom to Ugrasena, making the people happy and joyful.
content.transliteration:
Kaṃsa Vadha Kiyā Mathurā Jāī,
Mātā Pitā Ko Bandhana Se Chuḍāī.
Ugrasena Ko Rājya Dilāyā,
Prajā Sukhī Kara Ānanda Bhayā.

content.shloka:
Dwaarika Nagri Basi Leeni,
Rukmini Sang Shaadi Keeni.
Satyabhama Aru Ashta Rani,
Sab Jan Ki Tum Antaryaami.
content.meaning: You established yourself in the city of Dwarka and married Rukmini. With Satyabhama and the eight queens, you are the inner knower of all beings.
content.transliteration:
Dvārikā Nagarī Basī Līnī,
Rukmiṇī Saṅga Śādī Kīnī.
Satyabhāmā Aru Aṣṭa Rānī,
Saba Jana Kī Tuma Antaryāmī.

content.shloka:
Pandav Priy Madhav Murari,
Droupadi Ki Laaj Nivaari.
Mahabharat Ke Sarathi Bhaye,
Parthasarathi Naam Kahaye.
content.meaning: O Madhava Murari, beloved of the Pandavas, you preserved Draupadi's honor. You became the charioteer in the Mahabharata and were called Parthasarathi.
content.transliteration:
Pāṇḍava Priya Mādhava Murārī,
Draupadī Kī Lāja Nivārī.
Mahābhārata Ke Sārathī Bhaye,
Pārthasārathī Nāma Kahāye.

content.shloka:
Geeta Gyaan Diya Arjun Ko,
Karam Yog Ka Maarg Bataya.
Dharm Sthapan Hit Avataar Liya,
Adharma Ka Naash Karaya.
content.meaning: You imparted the wisdom of the Gita to Arjuna and showed the path of Karma Yoga. You incarnated for the establishment of dharma and destroyed unrighteousness.
content.transliteration:
Gītā Jñāna Diyā Arjuna Ko,
Karma Yoga Kā Mārga Batāyā.
Dharma Sthāpana Hita Avatāra Liyā,
Adharma Kā Nāśa Karāyā.

content.shloka:
Nirgun Sargun Dono Roop,
Anant Koti Brahmand Swaroop.
Ksheer Sagar Par Shesh Shayi,
Lakshmi Sang Virajat Bhayi.
content.meaning: You have both formless and manifested forms, your being spans infinite millions of universes. You recline on Shesha in the ocean of milk, seated resplendently with Lakshmi.
content.transliteration:
Nirguṇa Sarguṇa Dono Rūpa,
Ananta Koṭi Brahmāṇḍa Svarūpa.
Kṣīra Sāgara Para Śeṣa Śāyī,
Lakṣmī Saṅga Virājata Bhāyī.

content.shloka:
Sankh Chakra Gada Padma Dhaari,
Chaturbbhuj Dhari Roop Murari.
Peet Vastra Tan Chhabi Chhaaye,
Vaijanti Maal Gal Shobaaye.
content.meaning: You hold the conch, discus, mace, and lotus in four arms, O Murari. Yellow garments adorn your body with splendor, and the Vaijanti garland beautifies your neck.
content.transliteration:
Śaṅkha Cakra Gadā Padma Dhārī,
Caturbhuja Dharī Rūpa Murārī.
Pīta Vastra Tana Chabi Chāye,
Vaijantī Māla Gala Śobhāye.

content.shloka:
Govind Madhav Madhusudan,
Bansi Bajaavat Mohan Mann.
Charanamrit Nij Bhaktan Ko,
Sadaa Mukti Sukh Pradan.
content.meaning: O Govinda, Madhava, Madhusudan, you enchant the mind playing the flute. You give the nectar of your feet to your devotees, always granting liberation and happiness.
content.transliteration:
Govinda Mādhava Madhusūdana,
Baṃsī Bajāvata Mohana Mana.
Caraṇāmṛta Nija Bhaktana Ko,
Sadā Mukti Sukha Pradāna.

content.shloka:
Sudama Ki Preet Nibhaai Tum,
Daaridrya Door Kiya Dham.
Bhakti Priy Prabhu Sadaa Tum,
Jo Bhajai So Paavat Aaraam.
content.meaning: You honored the love of Sudama and removed all his poverty at once. You always love devotion, O Lord, and whoever worships you finds peace.
content.transliteration:
Sudāmā Kī Prīta Nibhāī Tuma,
Dāridrya Dūra Kiyā Dhāma.
Bhakti Priya Prabhu Sadā Tuma,
Jo Bhajai So Pāvata Ārāma.

content.shloka:
Bhaag Bhaye Sab Jagat Ke,
Jab Shri Krishan Kahaaye.
Mira Ke Prabhu Giridhara,
Bhaktan Mein Mann Bhaaye.
content.meaning: The fortunes of the world awoke when they were called Shri Krishna. Lord Giridhar of Mira is beloved in the hearts of all devotees.
content.transliteration:
Bhāga Bhaye Saba Jagata Ke,
Jaba Śrī Kṛṣṇa Kahāye.
Mīrā Ke Prabhu Giridhara,
Bhaktana Meṃ Mana Bhāye.

content.shloka:
Chaurasi Lakh Yoni Mein Bhatke,
Bina Bhajan Sab Sookh Jhatke.
Krishna Sharanm Vrij Dham Gahe,
Bhav Saagar Se Paar Lahe.
content.meaning: Wandering through 8.4 million life forms, without worship all joys wither away. Take refuge in Krishna and embrace Vraja, and cross the ocean of worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Caurāsī Lākha Yoni Meṃ Bhaṭake,
Binā Bhajana Saba Sūkha Jhaṭake.
Kṛṣṇa Śaraṇam Vraja Dhāma Gahe,
Bhava Sāgara Se Pāra Lahe.

content.shloka:
Krishna Chalisa Nit Jo Gaavai,
Sab Sukh Sampati Ghar Aavai.
Bhav Sagar Se Uttar Jaai,
Param Dham Mein Vaas Paai.
content.meaning: Whoever sings the Krishna Chalisa daily, all happiness and wealth come to their home. They cross the ocean of worldly existence and attain the supreme abode.
content.transliteration:
Kṛṣṇa Cālīsā Nita Jo Gāvai,
Saba Sukha Sampati Ghara Āvai.
Bhava Sāgara Se Uttara Jāī,
Parama Dhāma Meṃ Vāsa Pāī.

content.shloka:
Jai Shri Krishna Jai Jai Shri Krishna,
Govind Hare Mukund Man Bhaavai.
Krishna Kripa Jo Nar Par Hovai,
So Nar Kabhi Nahi Dukhi Hovai.
content.meaning: Victory to Shri Krishna, Victory Victory to Shri Krishna. Govinda, Hari, Mukunda enchant the mind. Whoever receives Krishna's grace never suffers sorrow.
content.transliteration:
Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa Jaya Jaya Śrī Kṛṣṇa,
Govinda Hare Mukunda Mana Bhāvai.
Kṛṣṇa Kṛpā Jo Nara Para Hovai,
So Nara Kabhī Nahī Dukhī Hovai.

content.shloka:
Om Shri Lakshmi devi ko manau, kahi na sakat gun gaan.
Sahas badan Sheshnag jo, nahin pave paaravaar.
content.meaning: I worship Goddess Shri Lakshmi, whose virtues cannot be fully sung. Even the thousand-headed Sheshnag cannot find the extent of her glory.
content.transliteration:
Om Śrī Lakṣmī devī ko manau, kahī na sakat guṇa gāna.
Sahas badana Śeṣanāga jo, nahīṁ pāve pāravāra.

content.shloka:
Jai Jai Jagat Janani Jagadamba, Sabke tum ho aadhi.
Daridra mitavo dukh harni, tum Sabki sukhdaani.
content.meaning: Victory to the Mother of the Universe, you are the primordial source of all. You remove poverty and sorrow, you are the bestower of happiness to all.
content.transliteration:
Jai Jai Jagat Jananī Jagadambā, Sabake tum ho ādī.
Dāridra miṭāvo duḥkha haranī, tum Sabakī sukhadānī.

content.shloka:
Jis ghar mein tum rahati ho, wahan sab sadgun aaye.
Sab sambhav ho jaata hai, man ichchhit phal paaye.
content.meaning: In the home where you reside, all virtues come to dwell. Everything becomes possible, and one obtains the desired fruits of the heart.
content.transliteration:
Jis ghara meṁ tum rahatī ho, vahāṁ saba sadaguṇa āye.
Saba sambhava ho jātā hai, mana icchita phala pāye.

content.shloka:
Tum bin Vishnu pade jab nihare, tum bin pooja sab adhuri.
Riddhi siddhi tum donon bahen, tum prakat Bhavani uri.
content.meaning: Without you, even Vishnu's glory appears incomplete, without you all worship remains unfulfilled. Riddhi and Siddhi are both your sisters, you are the manifest form of Bhavani.
content.transliteration:
Tum bina Viṣṇu paḍe jaba nihāre, tum bina pūjā saba adhūrī.
Ṛddhi siddhi tum donoṁ bahena, tum prakaṭa Bhavānī ūrī.

content.shloka:
Kshirasagar mein aasan tera, sesh nag ke sang rahi.
Lakshmipati sang viraje sada, tribhuvan mein jag mahi.
content.meaning: Your seat is in the ocean of milk, abiding with Sheshanag. You are ever seated with Lakshmipati (Vishnu), glorious across the three worlds and the earth.
content.transliteration:
Kṣīrasāgara meṁ āsana terā, śeṣa nāga ke saṅga rahī.
Lakṣmīpati saṅga virāje sadā, tribhuvana meṁ jaga māhī.

content.shloka:
Swarna mukut chhavi shobha badi, hiranyagarbh ki shakti hai.
Kamala vimala tanu kaanti bhari, sarveshvari ki bhakti hai.
content.meaning: Adorned with a golden crown of great splendor, you are the power of Hiranyagarbha. Your lotus-pure body radiates brilliance, devotion to the supreme goddess.
content.transliteration:
Svarṇa mukuṭa chavi śobhā baḍī, hiraṇyagarbha kī śakti hai.
Kamalā vimalā tanu kānti bharī, sarveśvarī kī bhakti hai.

content.shloka:
Kamal virajat kamal par, kamal prabha ki dhaar.
Kamal nayana Hari ke sang mein, kamal swarup apaar.
content.meaning: The lotus sits upon the lotus, streaming with lotus radiance. With lotus-eyed Hari by your side, your lotus form is infinite.
content.transliteration:
Kamala virājata kamala para, kamala prabhā kī dhāra.
Kamala nayana Hari ke saṅga meṁ, kamala svarūpa apāra.

content.shloka:
Garud dhwaj ke sang tum aavo, dushtan ko samharo.
Devon ko abhay daan do, sajjan ko pyaro.
content.meaning: Come along with the one bearing the Garuda banner, vanquish the wicked. Grant fearlessness to the gods, beloved of the virtuous.
content.transliteration:
Garuḍa dhvaja ke saṅga tum āvo, duṣṭana ko saṁhāro.
Devon ko abhaya dāna do, sajjana ko pyāro.

content.shloka:
Saubhagya dayini dhan dayini, dhan dhanya ke bhaar.
Vidya buddhi gyan pradayini, gyaan ke bhandaar.
content.meaning: Bestower of good fortune, giver of wealth, abundance of grain and riches. Provider of learning, intellect and wisdom, storehouse of knowledge.
content.transliteration:
Saubhāgya dāyinī dhana dāyinī, dhana dhānya ke bhāra.
Vidyā buddhi jñāna pradāyinī, jñāna ke bhaṇḍāra.

content.shloka:
Tum chaaron yug mein pujit rahi, tum chaaron veda pradhaan.
Chaar bhuja chaar disha mein, tum haro sab ki haan.
content.meaning: You have been worshipped across all four ages, you are foremost in all four Vedas. With four arms spread across four directions, you fulfill the wishes of all.
content.transliteration:
Tum cāroṁ yuga meṁ pūjita rahī, tum cāroṁ veda pradhāna.
Cāra bhujā cāra diśā meṁ, tum haro saba kī hāna.

content.shloka:
Brahma Vishnu Shiv sahit teri, puja kare sansaar.
Indra Chandra aur Varun dev, kare tera jai-jaikaar.
content.meaning: Along with Brahma, Vishnu and Shiva, the entire world worships you. Indra, Chandra and Varuna, all sing your victory hymn.
content.transliteration:
Brahmā Viṣṇu Śiva sahita terī, pūjā kare saṁsāra.
Indra Candra aura Varuṇa deva, kare terā jai-jaikāra.

content.shloka:
Rishivar mukh se teri mahima, gaayi jaaye din rain.
Narad saarad muni sab gaaye, tere guna ke gain.
content.meaning: Great sages sing your glory from their lips day and night. Narad, Sharad, and all munis sing the songs of your virtues.
content.transliteration:
Ṛṣivara mukha se terī mahimā, gāyī jāye dina raina.
Nārada Śārada muni saba gāye, tere guṇa ke gaina.

content.shloka:
Shankhnidhih Padmanidhih donon, dhyaavat tera dhyaan.
Tum prakat karo jab dharti par, aave mangal shaan.
content.meaning: Both Shanknidhi and Padmanidhi meditate upon you. When you manifest on earth, auspiciousness and glory arrive.
content.transliteration:
Śaṅkhanidhiḥ Padmanidhiḥ donoṁ, dhyāvata terā dhyāna.
Tum prakaṭa karo jaba dharatī para, āve maṅgala śāna.

content.shloka:
Shubh lakshmi maa shubh dayini, shubh saheli sab thaam.
Dosh harini gun khaan mein, tere charanon mein pranaaam.
content.meaning: Auspicious Mother Lakshmi, bestower of auspiciousness, auspicious companion in all places. Remover of faults, mine of virtues, I bow at your holy feet.
content.transliteration:
Śubha Lakṣmī mā śubha dāyinī, śubha sahelī saba thāma.
Doṣa hāriṇī guṇa khāna meṁ, tere caraṇoṁ meṁ praṇāma.

content.shloka:
Nirmal mann se jo dhyave, uski bipda hari jaaye.
Sankat kate mithe kasht sab, mann vachhit phal paaye.
content.meaning: Whoever meditates with a pure heart, their calamities are removed. Troubles are cut, all hardships vanish, and one obtains the desired fruit.
content.transliteration:
Nirmala mana se jo dhyāve, usakī bipadā harī jāye.
Saṅkaṭa kaṭe miṭe kaṣṭa saba, mana vāñchita phala pāye.

content.shloka:
Maata Lakshmi ki jo nit puje, samridhhi bade chaahu or.
Sankat se bachaave Lakshmi, kare kripa ki bhor.
content.meaning: One who worships Mother Lakshmi daily, prosperity grows in all four directions. Lakshmi saves from calamity, bestowing the dawn of her grace.
content.transliteration:
Mātā Lakṣmī kī jo nita pūje, samṛddhi baḍhe cāhū ora.
Saṅkaṭa se bacāve Lakṣmī, kare kṛpā kī bhora.

content.shloka:
Dhan Vaibhav de aishvarya de, arogya kare pradaan.
Lakshmi maa ke jas gaavo, paavo param nidhaan.
content.meaning: She grants wealth, splendor and sovereignty, bestows good health. Sing the praises of Mother Lakshmi and attain the supreme treasure.
content.transliteration:
Dhana vaibhava de aiśvarya de, ārogya kare pradāna.
Lakṣmī mā ke jasa gāvo, pāvo parama nidhāna.

content.shloka:
Grih klesha mite ghar mein teri, koti siddhi de daan.
Lakshmi vandana kare sada jo, paave padam nidhaan.
content.meaning: Household strife vanishes from the home where you dwell, you grant ten million accomplishments. One who always praises Lakshmi attains the lotus treasure.
content.transliteration:
Gṛha kleśa miṭe ghara meṁ terī, koṭi siddhi de dāna.
Lakṣmī vandanā kare sadā jo, pāve padma nidhāna.

content.shloka:
Sankat hare dukh mite sab, jo sumire man laaye.
Sukhsampatti ghar aave sada, Lakshmi maa man bhaaye.
content.meaning: All troubles and sorrows are removed for one who remembers you with a focused mind. Happiness and prosperity forever fill the home when Mother Lakshmi is pleased.
content.transliteration:
Saṅkaṭa hare duḥkha miṭe saba, jo sumire mana lāye.
Sukhasampatti ghara āve sadā, Lakṣmī mā mana bhāye.

content.shloka:
Lakshmi chalisa jo nit gaave, sab sukh sampatti paaye.
Anand mangal barse sada, kabhi na dukh sataye.
|| Doha ||
Shri Lakshmi maa ke charan mein, mera yahi ardaas.
Kripa karahu mata aap ki, poorn karahu meri aas.
content.meaning:
One who daily recites the Lakshmi Chalisa obtains all happiness and prosperity. Joy and auspiciousness shower always, and sorrow never torments.
|| Doha ||
At the feet of Mother Shri Lakshmi, this is my humble prayer. Bestow your grace, O Mother, and fulfill my hope.
content.transliteration:
Lakṣmī calīsā jo nita gāve, saba sukha sampatti pāye.
Ānanda maṅgala barase sadā, kabhī na duḥkha satāye.
|| Dohā ||
Śrī Lakṣmī mā ke caraṇa meṁ, merā yahī ardāsa.
Kṛpā karahu mātā āpa kī, pūrṇa karahu merī āsa.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Jag mein sakala Saraswati, de mukhi gyaan apar.
Karahu kripa jag janani, duru karahu andhiyaar.
|| Chaupai ||
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
In the world, Saraswati bestows boundless knowledge through her speech. O Mother of the world, bestow your grace and remove all darkness.
|| Chaupai ||
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Jaga meṁ sakala Sarasvatī, de mukhī jñāna apāra.
Karahu kṛpā jaga jananī, dūru karahu andhiyāra.
|| Caupāī ||

content.shloka:
Jai Jai Jai Saraswati Bhavani, Jai Jai Jai gunavant gyaani.
Hans vahan par sushobhit, Shubhra vastra sab chahit.
content.meaning: Victory, victory to Saraswati Bhavani, victory to the virtuous and wise. Beautifully seated upon the swan, clothed in white garments desired by all.
content.transliteration:
Jai Jai Jai Sarasvatī Bhavānī, Jai Jai Jai guṇavanta jñānī.
Haṁsa vāhana para suśobhita, Śubhra vastra saba cāhita.

content.shloka:
Pustak haath virajat niko, Maalin mukta maniko.
Othi shobha mukh par bhaari, Desh desh ke gyaan adhikaari.
content.meaning: The book adorns your hand beautifully, with a garland of pearls and gems. Great splendor graces your lips, you are the sovereign of knowledge in every land.
content.transliteration:
Pustaka hātha virājata nīko, Mālinī muktā maṇiko.
Oṭhī śobhā mukha para bhārī, Deśa deśa ke jñāna adhikārī.

content.shloka:
Ratna jadit singhaasan par, Viraje tum varada datar.
Veena pustak dhaarani, Bhav sagar se udhaarani.
content.meaning: Seated upon a jewel-studded throne, you preside as the giver of boons. You hold the veena and the book, the one who rescues from the ocean of worldly existence.
content.transliteration:
Ratna jaḍita siṁhāsana para, Virāje tum varada dātāra.
Vīṇā pustaka dhāraṇī, Bhava sāgara se uddhāraṇī.

content.shloka:
Kamal ke aasan par biraje, Sahaj bhaav mein dhyaan lagaye.
Sunn sunn vidya daan karein, Sabko gyaan pradaan karein.
content.meaning: You sit upon a lotus seat, absorbed in natural meditation. Ever listening, you bestow the gift of learning, granting knowledge to all.
content.transliteration:
Kamala ke āsana para birāje, Sahaja bhāva meṁ dhyāna lagāye.
Suna suna vidyā dāna kareṁ, Sabako jñāna pradāna kareṁ.

content.shloka:
Brahma ke mann se tum pragate, Sakal jeev jag ko sukh diye.
Vidya Lakshmi dharm prakat kiye, Aur gyaan ka deep jaliye.
content.meaning: You manifested from the mind of Brahma, granting happiness to all beings in the world. You revealed learning, prosperity and dharma, and lit the lamp of knowledge.
content.transliteration:
Brahmā ke mana se tum pragaṭe, Sakala jīva jaga ko sukha diye.
Vidyā Lakṣmī dharma prakaṭa kiye, Aura jñāna kā dīpa jaliye.

content.shloka:
Rishi muni saadhu sab dhyaavein, Ved Puraan Shaastra bataavein.
Tum se paavein gyaan sar, Vidya ke tum ho aadhar.
content.meaning: Sages, munis and saints all meditate upon you, the Vedas, Puranas and scriptures proclaim you. From you they receive the essence of knowledge, you are the very foundation of learning.
content.transliteration:
Ṛṣi muni sādhu saba dhyāveṁ, Veda Purāṇa Śāstra batāveṁ.
Tum se pāveṁ jñāna sāra, Vidyā ke tum ho ādhāra.

content.shloka:
Kumati nivaarini buddhi de do, Sakala guna vaani vidya de do.
Subuddhi vichar ek man mein, Sabke hriday gyaan bhar do.
content.meaning: Remove evil thinking and grant intellect, bestow all virtuous speech and learning. Place right wisdom and thought in every mind, fill the hearts of all with knowledge.
content.transliteration:
Kumati nivāriṇī buddhi de do, Sakala guṇa vāṇī vidyā de do.
Subuddhi vicāra eka mana meṁ, Sabake hṛdaya jñāna bhara do.

content.shloka:
Vidyarthi ko vidya do, Arthi ko dhan sampada do.
Sukharthi ko sukh do Saraswati, Muktarthi ko moksha pada do.
content.meaning: Grant knowledge to the student, give wealth and prosperity to the seeker. O Saraswati, give happiness to one who seeks joy, and grant the state of liberation to the aspirant of freedom.
content.transliteration:
Vidyārthī ko vidyā do, Arthī ko dhana sampadā do.
Sukhārthī ko sukha do Sarasvatī, Muktārthī ko mokṣa pada do.

content.shloka:
Shwetambari Shweta varna ki, Shweta kamal aasan sthit.
Shweta haaron se sajit, Sarvada shanti pradit.
content.meaning: Clothed in white, of white complexion, seated on a white lotus. Adorned with white garlands, ever radiating peace.
content.transliteration:
Śvetāmbarī śveta varṇa kī, Śveta kamala āsana sthita.
Śveta hāroṁ se sajita, Sarvadā śānti prādita.

content.shloka:
Kala kavita sahitya rasdhaari, Sangeet sunaaye sab hitkaari.
Katha kavitt dohe chhand rachein, Gyaan vigyan prakat prachein.
content.meaning: Bearer of the essence of art, poetry and literature, you play music that benefits all. Narratives, poems, couplets and verses you compose, spreading knowledge and science.
content.transliteration:
Kalā kavitā sāhitya rasadhārī, Saṅgīta sunāye saba hitakārī.
Kathā kavitta dohe chanda raceṁ, Jñāna vijñāna prakaṭa praceṁ.

content.shloka:
Chaturdash vidya ke adhishthaan, Chatursashti kala ke pradhan.
Sakala shastra ke gyaan sar, Tum ho sakala vidya aadhar.
content.meaning: You are the seat of the fourteen branches of knowledge, the chief of the sixty-four arts. You hold the essence of all scriptures, you are the foundation of all learning.
content.transliteration:
Caturdaśa vidyā ke adhiṣṭhāna, Catuḥṣaṣṭi kalā ke pradhāna.
Sakala śāstra ke jñāna sāra, Tum ho sakala vidyā ādhāra.

content.shloka:
Namo Namo Vaagdevi Saraswati, Namo Namo sab vidya daati.
Namo Namo Kamaladal vaasini, Namo Namo sab buddhi vilaasini.
content.meaning: Salutations, salutations to Vaagdevi Saraswati, salutations to the giver of all knowledge. Salutations to the one who dwells on the lotus petal, salutations to the one who sports in all intellects.
content.transliteration:
Namo Namo Vāgdevī Sarasvatī, Namo Namo saba vidyā dātī.
Namo Namo Kamaladala vāsinī, Namo Namo saba buddhi vilāsinī.

content.shloka:
Moorkhata door karahu Bhavani, Sunahu hamari arj baani.
Gyaan deep jala ujiyaar karo, Avidya timira andhaar haro.
content.meaning: Remove foolishness, O Bhavani, hear our humble plea. Light the lamp of knowledge and bring illumination, remove the darkness of ignorance.
content.transliteration:
Mūrkhatā dūra karahu Bhavānī, Sunahu hamārī araja bānī.
Jñāna dīpa jalā ujiyāra karo, Avidyā timira andhāra haro.

content.shloka:
Har mann mein prakat ho gyaan, Buddhi vivek ka barse daan.
Sab vidyarthi sukh paavein, Pariksha mein jayee ho jaavein.
content.meaning: May knowledge manifest in every heart, may the gift of intellect and discernment rain down. May all students attain happiness, may they be victorious in examinations.
content.transliteration:
Hara mana meṁ prakaṭa ho jñāna, Buddhi viveka kā barase dāna.
Saba vidyārthī sukha pāveṁ, Parīkṣā meṁ jayī ho jāveṁ.

content.shloka:
Kavi jan paayen kavitt rasa, Lekhak ko mile lekh suvilaas.
Sangeetkar ko sur de do, Kalaakar ko ek aadhar de do.
content.meaning: May poets receive the nectar of poetry, may writers find the joy of composition. Grant melodious notes to musicians, provide a foundation for artists.
content.transliteration:
Kavi jana pāyeṁ kavitta rasa, Lekhaka ko mile lekha suvilāsa.
Saṅgītakāra ko sura de do, Kalākāra ko eka ādhāra de do.

content.shloka:
Tum ho gyaan ki dhara nirmal, Tum ho buddhi ki khaan amol.
Vaani tumhari amrit jaisi, Saraswati maa kripa kaisi.
content.meaning: You are the pure stream of knowledge, you are the priceless mine of intellect. Your speech is like nectar, such is the grace of Mother Saraswati.
content.transliteration:
Tum ho jñāna kī dhārā nirmala, Tum ho buddhi kī khāna amola.
Vāṇī tumhārī amṛta jaisī, Sarasvatī mā kṛpā kaisī.

content.shloka:
Japo Saraswati naam sab, Nitya niyam se dhyaan karo.
Saraswati ke charno mein, Arpan mann aur praan karo.
content.meaning: Chant the name of Saraswati, all of you, meditate with daily discipline. At the feet of Saraswati, offer your mind and life.
content.transliteration:
Japo Sarasvatī nāma saba, Nitya niyama se dhyāna karo.
Sarasvatī ke caraṇoṁ meṁ, Arpaṇa mana aura prāṇa karo.

content.shloka:
Jo koi pathe padhe sunave, So sukh sampatti gyaan paave.
Vidya buddhi maan badhave, Saraswati mann bhaave.
content.meaning: Whoever recites, reads, or listens to this, obtains happiness, prosperity and knowledge. Their learning, wisdom and honor increase, and Saraswati is pleased in their heart.
content.transliteration:
Jo koī pāṭhe paḍhe sunāve, So sukha sampatti jñāna pāve.
Vidyā buddhi māna baḍhāve, Sarasvatī mana bhāve.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Saraswati chalisa padhe, man mein dharke dhyaan.
Kripaalu ho Vaagdevi tab, dein vidya vardaan.
Jai Saraswati Mata Jai Jai Saraswati Mata.
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
One who recites the Saraswati Chalisa holding meditation in the heart, the merciful Vaagdevi then bestows the boon of knowledge. Victory to Mother Saraswati, victory, victory to Mother Saraswati.
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Sarasvatī calīsā paḍhe, mana meṁ dharake dhyāna.
Kṛpālu ho Vāgdevī taba, deṁ vidyā varadāna.
Jai Sarasvatī Mātā Jai Jai Sarasvatī Mātā.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Nishchay premi vinay suni, sharad grahi mati dheer.
Bajrang baan yeh sakshi hai, Hanuman ati balveer.
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
Hearing the humble prayer of a devoted worshipper, with steadfast and wise mind, this Bajrang Baan is witness that Hanuman is supremely mighty.
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Niścaya premī vinaya sunī, śārada grahī mati dhīra.
Bajraṅga bāṇa yaha sākṣī hai, Hanumāna ati balavīra.

content.shloka:
Jai Hanumant sant hitkaari, Suni leeje prabhu arj hamaari.
Jan ke kaaj vilamb na keeje, Aatur daudi maha sukh deeje.
content.meaning: Victory to Hanuman, benefactor of saints, please hear our petition, O Lord. Do not delay in the work of your devotees, rush eagerly and grant great happiness.
content.transliteration:
Jai Hanumanta santa hitakārī, Suni līje prabhu araja hamārī.
Jana ke kāja vilamba na kīje, Ātura dauḍi mahā sukha dīje.

content.shloka:
Jaise koodhi sindhu mahi paara, Sursa badhan mukhi beeda pasaara.
Jaise biraaj Dron upaari, Aaye Lakhan praan ubhaari.
content.meaning: Just as you leapt across the great ocean, expanding your mouth wide past the demoness Surasa. Just as you uprooted Mount Dronagiri and came to revive the life of Lakshmana.
content.transliteration:
Jaise kūdhi sindhu māhī pāra, Surasā badhana mukhī bīḍā pasārā.
Jaise birāja Droṇa upārī, Āye Lakhaṇa prāṇa ubhārī.

content.shloka:
Jaise Sita sudhi laaye prabhu pehi, Bani baithak Raghunaath sanehi.
Jaise Lanka jaari kar aaye, Siya Ram kaaj sakal banaaye.
content.meaning: Just as you brought news of Sita to the Lord, becoming the trusted companion of Raghunath. Just as you burned Lanka and returned, accomplishing all the tasks of Sita and Ram.
content.transliteration:
Jaise Sītā sudhi lāye prabhu pehī, Bani baiṭhaka Raghunātha sanehī.
Jaise Laṅkā jāri kara āye, Siyā Rāma kāja sakala banāye.

content.shloka:
Aisi kripa keeje Hanumanta, Jan ke praan rahe ati santa.
Yahi te Bajrang Baan kahave, Taki taki shatru samhaarave.
content.meaning: Bestow such grace O Hanuman, that the devotee's spirit remains utterly at peace. This is why it is called the Bajrang Baan (arrow of Bajrang), it takes aim and destroys enemies.
content.transliteration:
Aisī kṛpā kīje Hanumanta, Jana ke prāṇa rahe ati śānta.
Yahī te Bajraṅga Bāṇa kahāve, Tākī tākī śatru saṁhārave.

content.shloka:
Om Hriim Hriim Hriim Hanumat kapish, Khol diyo taaree ati jagadish.
Satya hosi Hari shapath tumhaari, Sunahu Veershvar vinay hamaari.
content.meaning: Om Hrim Hrim Hrim, Hanuman, chief of monkeys, the supreme Lord has opened the way for you. Your oath to Hari is true, hear O bravest Lord, our humble prayer.
content.transliteration:
Om Hrīṁ Hrīṁ Hrīṁ Hanumata kapīśa, Khola diyo tārī ati jagadīśa.
Satya hosī Hari śapatha tumhārī, Sunahu Vīreśvara vinaya hamārī.

content.shloka:
Jan ki laaj raakhahu dayal, Aisi binati karat ghari ghari.
Sunahu Pavanputra pavankumar, Bharahu mann aasha praan se pyaare.
content.meaning: Protect the honor of your devotee, O merciful one, such is the plea made every moment. Hear, O son of Pavan, O wind-born prince, fill the heart with hope, dearer than life.
content.transliteration:
Jana kī lāja rākhahu dayāla, Aisī binatī karata gharī gharī.
Sunahu Pavanaputra pavanakumāra, Bharahu mana āśā prāṇa se pyāre.

content.shloka:
Om Hanumate Namah kahi dhyaavein, Sankat mochan sab dukh jaavein.
Nishidin dhyaan dharahu Kapi raaya, Karo sada jan par sahaya.
content.meaning: Those who meditate saying Om Hanumate Namah, all sorrows depart through the deliverer from calamity. Day and night keep your focus, O King of monkeys, always come to the aid of your devotees.
content.transliteration:
Om Hanumate Namaḥ kahi dhyāveṁ, Saṅkaṭa mocana saba duḥkha jāveṁ.
Niśidina dhyāna dharahu Kapi rāyā, Karo sadā jana para sahāyā.

content.shloka:
Bhoot pret pishaach nikat nahi aave, Mahaveer jab naam sunaave.
Aankhi na dekhi kaanha na sooni, Mahaveer ka naam jo looni.
content.meaning: Ghosts, spirits, and demons dare not come near when the name of Mahavir is proclaimed. Eyes have not seen, ears have not heard any who took the name of Mahavir and were not saved.
content.transliteration:
Bhūta preta piśāca nikaṭa nahīṁ āve, Mahāvīra jaba nāma sunāve.
Āṅkhī na dekhī kānhā na sūnī, Mahāvīra kā nāma jo lūnī.

content.shloka:
Raakh raakh raakh Hanumant, Choro mat chhodo Bhagvant.
Jaani jaani jaani jan ki baat, Tab Hanumat aaye prabhaat.
content.meaning: Protect, protect, protect O Hanuman, do not leave, do not let go, O divine Lord. Know, know, know the plight of your devotee, then Hanuman arrives at dawn.
content.transliteration:
Rākha rākha rākha Hanumanta, Choro mata choḍo Bhagavanta.
Jānī jānī jānī jana kī bāta, Taba Hanumata āye prabhāta.

content.shloka:
Prem prateeti ke matt dolarahu, Tab Kapi isha turat phaldolarahu.
Jan ki aarti leejai suni, Turant kaaj karo Kapimuni.
content.meaning: Do not waver in love and faith, then the Lord of monkeys immediately bears fruit. Hear the distress of the devotee, accomplish the task at once, O wise Kapi.
content.transliteration:
Prema pratīti ke mata ḍolāhu, Taba Kapi īśa turata phaladolāhu.
Jana kī āratī lījai sunī, Turanta kāja karo Kapimunī.

content.shloka:
Utha utha chal soi savaari, Aano kaaj sakala tumhaari.
Aisan karahu veer Hanumanta, Jaiso kaahu Sugriv ke santa.
content.meaning: Rise, rise and go forth, O warrior, all the tasks are yours to accomplish. Act thus, O brave Hanuman, just as you did for the saint Sugriva.
content.transliteration:
Uṭha uṭha cala soī savārī, Āno kāja sakala tumhārī.
Aisana karahu vīra Hanumanta, Jaiso kāhu Sugrīva ke santa.

content.shloka:
Deejat turant krodh ab aaye, Mahaveer bal apni dikhaaye.
Asi kripa keeje Kapiraai, Jan ke sankat turat mitaai.
content.meaning: Now come forth with righteous fury, O Mahavir, show your great might. Bestow such grace, O king of monkeys, that the devotee's troubles are instantly removed.
content.transliteration:
Dījata turanta krodha aba āye, Mahāvīra bala apanī dikhāye.
Asī kṛpā kīje Kapirāī, Jana ke saṅkaṭa turata miṭāī.

content.shloka:
Om Namo Om Namo Om Namo, Om Namo Om Hanumate balbheem.
Bajrang Baan ko padhe sada jo, Uski sab vipadaa hai na kadaapi ho.
content.meaning: Om Namo Om Namo Om Namo, Om Namo Om to the mighty and powerful Hanuman. One who always recites the Bajrang Baan, shall never face any calamity.
content.transliteration:
Om Namo Om Namo Om Namo, Om Namo Om Hanumate balabhīma.
Bajraṅga Bāṇa ko paḍhe sadā jo, Usakī saba vipadā hai na kadāpi ho.

content.shloka:
Sankat kate mithe sab peera, Jab japo Hanuman balveera.
Bajrang Baan yeh sakshi hai, Hanuman bhakt nidhi hai.
|| Doha ||
Pavan Tanay Sankat Haran, Mangal Murti Roop.
Ram Lakhan Sita sahit, Hriday basahu sur bhoop.
content.meaning:
All troubles are cut and all pains vanish when you chant the name of the mighty Hanuman. This Bajrang Baan is witness that Hanuman is the treasure of devotees.
|| Doha ||
O son of the wind, remover of calamities, embodiment of auspicious form. Along with Ram, Lakhan and Sita, dwell within my heart, O king among gods.
content.transliteration:
Saṅkaṭa kaṭe miṭhe saba pīrā, Jaba japo Hanumāna balavīrā.
Bajraṅga Bāṇa yaha sākṣī hai, Hanumāna bhakta nidhi hai.
|| Dohā ||
Pavana Tanaya Saṅkaṭa Haraṇa, Maṅgala Mūrti Rūpa.
Rāma Lakhaṇa Sītā sahita, Hṛdaya basahu sura bhūpa.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Namo Namo Shri Vishnu ji, karu kripa bhandar.
Grih klesha mite sab ke, karahu sabka uddhaar.
|| Chaupai ||
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
Salutations to Lord Shri Vishnu, the treasury of grace. Remove all household afflictions and bring salvation to all.
|| Chaupai ||
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Namo Namo Śrī Viṣṇu jī, karu kṛpā bhaṇḍāra.
Gṛha kleśa miṭe saba ke, karahu sabakā uddhāra.
|| Caupāī ||

content.shloka:
Jai Lakshmi Ramana jai gopal, Jai Devaki Nandan dayal.
Jai Shri Hari Vishnu Narayan, Kshirsagar mein karat vilaasan.
content.meaning: Victory to the beloved of Lakshmi, victory to Gopal. Victory to the compassionate son of Devaki. Victory to Shri Hari Vishnu Narayan, who reposes in the ocean of milk.
content.transliteration:
Jai Lakṣmī Ramaṇa jai gopāla, Jai Devakī Nandana dayāla.
Jai Śrī Hari Viṣṇu Nārāyaṇa, Kṣīrasāgara meṁ karata vilāsana.

content.shloka:
Shesha shaiyya par baithe Hari, Lakshmi charaan dabaavein vaari.
Garud vahan baith ke aavein, Sankhya chakra padma Hari paavein.
content.meaning: Hari reclines on the bed of Shesha, while Lakshmi lovingly presses his feet. He arrives seated upon Garuda, wielding the conch, discus and lotus.
content.transliteration:
Śeṣa śaiyyā para baiṭhe Hari, Lakṣmī caraṇa dabāveṁ vārī.
Garuḍa vāhana baiṭha ke āveṁ, Śaṅkha cakra padma Hari pāveṁ.

content.shloka:
Pitambar phool sahit tan sohe, Dev danav muni darshankohe.
Neel kanth vanamala dhaari, Kaustubh mani urr shobhakaari.
content.meaning: The yellow silk garment adorned with flowers graces his body, gods, demons and sages all yearn for his sight. Blue-throated, wearing the forest garland, the Kaustubha gem adorns his chest beautifully.
content.transliteration:
Pītāmbara phūla sahita tana sohe, Deva dānava muni darśankohe.
Nīla kaṇṭha vanamālā dhārī, Kaustubha maṇi ura śobhākārī.

content.shloka:
Makarkrit kundal shat sohe, Mukh madhur chhavi dekhi mann mohe.
