Shridhar Vishnu Vishvaroop dhari, Sahastrabahu chatur mudra dhari.
content.meaning: Makara-shaped earrings adorn you beautifully, the sweet radiance of your face enchants the mind. Shridhar Vishnu assumes the Universal Form, with a thousand arms bearing the four sacred gestures.
content.transliteration:
Makarakṛta kuṇḍala śata sohe, Mukha madhura chavi dekhi mana mohe.
Śrīdhara Viṣṇu Viśvarūpa dharī, Sahasrabāhu catura mudrā dharī.

content.shloka:
Brahma rudra tav ang se pragate, Chaudah bhuvan tav se uchare.
Racha paale aur sanghaare Hari, Tribhuvan ke tum praan adhaari.
content.meaning: Brahma and Rudra arose from your body, the fourteen worlds emerged from you. You create, sustain and dissolve, O Hari, you are the life-support of the three worlds.
content.transliteration:
Brahmā Rudra tava aṅga se pragaṭe, Caudaha bhuvana tava se ucare.
Racā pāle aura saṅhāre Hari, Tribhuvana ke tum prāṇa ādhārī.

content.shloka:
Dashavatar tum lete aayo, Bhakt suraksha hit gun gaayo.
Matsya Kurma Varah avtar, Narsimha Vaman parakram dhaar.
content.meaning: You have taken the ten avatars, singing the virtues of devotee protection. Matsya, Kurma, Varaha incarnations, Narasimha and Vamana wielding great valor.
content.transliteration:
Daśāvatāra tum lete āyo, Bhakta surakṣā hita guṇa gāyo.
Matsya Kūrma Varāha avatāra, Narasiṁha Vāmana parākrama dhāra.

content.shloka:
Parashurama Shri Rama avtar, Krishna Buddha Kalki aadhar.
Dasho avataron mein teri leela, Bhakt taarev sab ka pratipala.
content.meaning: Parashurama, Shri Rama incarnation, Krishna, Buddha, and Kalki as the foundation. In all ten avatars your divine play unfolds, ferrying devotees across and nourishing all.
content.transliteration:
Paraśurāma Śrī Rāma avatāra, Kṛṣṇa Buddha Kalkī ādhāra.
Daśo avatāroṁ meṁ terī līlā, Bhakta tāreṁ saba kā pratipālā.

content.shloka:
Sudarshan chakra Garud pe aaye, Dushtan ko pal mein mitaaye.
Sajan ko de abhay daan, Hari karein sabka kalyaan.
content.meaning: Coming upon Garuda with the Sudarshana chakra, you destroy the wicked in an instant. You grant the boon of fearlessness to the virtuous, Hari brings welfare to all.
content.transliteration:
Sudarśana cakra Garuḍa pe āye, Duṣṭana ko pala meṁ miṭāye.
Sajana ko de abhaya dāna, Hari kareṁ sabakā kalyāṇa.

content.shloka:
Prahlad bachaye Hiranyakashyap maare, Gaj ko graha se aaye ubhaare.
Dhruv ko diye amar pad daani, Aisi kripa kare Bhagvaani.
content.meaning: You saved Prahlad and slew Hiranyakashipu, you rescued the elephant from the crocodile. You gave Dhruva the imperishable position, such is the grace of the Lord.
content.transliteration:
Prahlāda bacāye Hiraṇyakaśyapu māre, Gaja ko graha se āye ubhāre.
Dhruva ko diye amara pada dānī, Aisī kṛpā kare Bhagavānī.

content.shloka:
Draupadi ki laaj tum raakhi, Kaurav sabha mein cheer badhaakhi.
Vidur Sudama ke prem ke saathi, Aise dayalu Jagannathi.
content.meaning: You protected the honor of Draupadi, extending her garment endlessly in the Kaurava court. The companion of Vidura and Sudama's love, such is the compassionate Lord of the World.
content.transliteration:
Draupadī kī lāja tum rākhī, Kaurava sabhā meṁ cīra baḍhākhī.
Vidura Sudāmā ke prema ke sāthī, Aise dayālu Jagannāthī.

content.shloka:
Geet amrit mukh se barasey, Arjun ko gyaan diye base.
Geeta sar suno Narayan, Karm karo phal mero daani.
content.meaning: Nectar of the Gita flowed from your lips, you bestowed the essence of knowledge upon Arjuna. Hear the essence of the Gita, O Narayan: perform your duty, I am the bestower of the fruit.
content.transliteration:
Gītā amṛta mukha se barase, Arjuna ko jñāna diye base.
Gītā sāra suno Nārāyaṇa, Karma karo phala mero dānī.

content.shloka:
Narad muni Hari Hari gaavein, Sanakadik tere gun batlaavein.
Shesh Mahesh sada gun gaate, Tav charitra jagat mein chhaate.
content.meaning: Sage Narada sings Hari Hari, the Sanaka sages describe your virtues. Sheshanag and Mahesh always sing your glory, your deeds spread across the world.
content.transliteration:
Nārada muni Hari Hari gāveṁ, Sanakādika tere guṇa batalāveṁ.
Śeṣa Maheśa sadā guṇa gāte, Tava caritra jagata meṁ chāte.

content.shloka:
Ved Puraan sakala gun gaaye, Tav charanaamrit ko sukh paaye.
Tulsi Surdas premi je gaaye, Sab mann mein Hari darsh dikhaaye.
content.meaning: The Vedas and Puranas all sing your virtues, finding bliss in the nectar of your feet. Tulsi, Surdas, and loving devotees have sung, revealing Hari's vision in every heart.
content.transliteration:
Veda Purāṇa sakala guṇa gāye, Tava caraṇāmṛta ko sukha pāye.
Tulasī Sūradāsa premī je gāye, Saba mana meṁ Hari darśa dikhāye.

content.shloka:
Nirgun sagun swarup tumhara, Sagun roop mann bhaave pyaara.
Japo Vishnu Vishnu Hari naam, Paavo anand param dham.
content.meaning: Both formless and with form is your nature, the manifest form is dear and pleasing to the heart. Chant Vishnu, Vishnu, Hari's name, attain bliss and the supreme abode.
content.transliteration:
Nirguṇa saguṇa svarūpa tumhārā, Saguṇa rūpa mana bhāve pyārā.
Japo Viṣṇu Viṣṇu Hari nāma, Pāvo ānanda parama dhāma.

content.shloka:
Daya dharma ka karo vichar, Satya ahimsa mein karo pyar.
Hari bhajan mein mann lagaye, Janm maran ke bandhan jaaye.
content.meaning: Reflect upon compassion and dharma, love truth and non-violence. Engage the mind in the worship of Hari, and the bonds of birth and death shall be severed.
content.transliteration:
Dayā dharma kā karo vicāra, Satya ahiṁsā meṁ karo pyāra.
Hari bhajana meṁ mana lagāye, Janma maraṇa ke bandhana jāye.

content.shloka:
Hari chalisa jo nit gaave, Janm janm ke paap mitaave.
Anand mangal barse sada, Hari kripa se mile Hridaya mein sadaa.
content.meaning: One who daily recites the Hari Chalisa has the sins of many lifetimes erased. Joy and auspiciousness rain always, by Hari's grace the heart is forever fulfilled.
content.transliteration:
Hari calīsā jo nita gāve, Janma janma ke pāpa miṭāve.
Ānanda maṅgala barase sadā, Hari kṛpā se mile hṛdaya meṁ sadā.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Vishnu chalisa padhe jo koi, mann vachhit phal paave soi.
Kripaalu hoi Narayan tab, Sabhi sankat kate saab.
Jai Shri Vishnu Jai Shri Hari, Jai Jagadish Murari.
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
Whoever recites the Vishnu Chalisa obtains the desired fruit. When Narayan becomes merciful, all calamities are cut away. Victory to Shri Vishnu, victory to Shri Hari, victory to the Lord of the World, Murari.
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Viṣṇu calīsā paḍhe jo koī, mana vāñchita phala pāve soī.
Kṛpālu hoī Nārāyaṇa taba, Sabhī saṅkaṭa kaṭe sāba.
Jai Śrī Viṣṇu Jai Śrī Hari, Jai Jagadīśa Murārī.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Koti koti suraj sa prabha, tejo punj bhagvaan.
Karahu kripa Bhaskar prabhu, rakshahu jan ke praan.
|| Chaupai ||
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
With the radiance of billions of suns, O Lord who is a mass of brilliance. Bestow your grace, O Lord Bhaskar, protect the lives of your devotees.
|| Chaupai ||
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Koṭi koṭi sūraja sā prabhā, tejo puñja bhagavāna.
Karahu kṛpā Bhāskara prabhu, rakṣahu jana ke prāṇa.
|| Caupāī ||

content.shloka:
Jai Jai Jai Ravi Bhagvaan, Jai Suryanarayan bhagvaan.
Kashyap Aditi ke nandan, Tribhuvan timirahari chandan.
content.meaning: Victory, victory to Lord Ravi, victory to Lord Suryanarayan. Son of Kashyap and Aditi, the sandalwood that removes darkness of the three worlds.
content.transliteration:
Jai Jai Jai Ravi Bhagavāna, Jai Sūryanārāyaṇa bhagavāna.
Kaśyapa Aditi ke nandana, Tribhuvana timirāharī candana.

content.shloka:
Sapt ashwa rath sushobhit, Arun sarathi karat sevit.
Ekchakra rath mein biraje, Tamo naashak Bhanu viraje.
content.meaning: Splendidly seated in a chariot drawn by seven horses, served by the charioteer Aruna. You sit in the single-wheeled chariot, Bhanu, the destroyer of darkness, shines forth.
content.transliteration:
Sapta aśva ratha suśobhita, Aruṇa sārathī karata sevita.
Ekacakra ratha meṁ birāje, Tamo nāśaka Bhānu virāje.

content.shloka:
Dvadash roop dharin Suryanarayan, Mitra Ravi Surya Bhanu Khaga Pusha bhagvaan.
Hiranyagarbh Marichih Aaditya, Savita Arka Bhaskara nityam.
content.meaning: Suryanarayan bears twelve forms: Mitra, Ravi, Surya, Bhanu, Khaga, Pusha, Lord. Hiranyagarbha, Marichi, Aditya, Savitar, Arka, Bhaskara — eternal.
content.transliteration:
Dvādaśa rūpa dhariṁ Sūryanārāyaṇa, Mitra Ravi Sūrya Bhānu Khaga Pūṣā bhagavāna.
Hiraṇyagarbha Marīciḥ Ādityā, Savitā Arka Bhāskara nityam.

content.shloka:
Pratyaksh devo Suryanaraayan, Jag ke praandata karein kalyaan.
Tumse pragatein sakala sansaar, Tumse hove srishti vistaar.
content.meaning: The visible deity, Suryanarayan, the giver of life to the world who brings welfare. From you the entire world manifests, from you creation expands.
content.transliteration:
Pratyakṣa devo Sūryanārāyaṇa, Jaga ke prāṇadātā kareṁ kalyāṇa.
Tumase pragateṁ sakala saṁsāra, Tumase hove sṛṣṭi vistāra.

content.shloka:
Tumhari kirno se jag jeevan, Tumhare tej se mile nava jeevan.
Annadaata tum jagat ke, Sakala jeev jeevan ke.
content.meaning: From your rays the world receives life, from your radiance new life is bestowed. You are the provider of food for the world, the life of all living beings.
content.transliteration:
Tumhārī kiraṇoṁ se jaga jīvana, Tumhāre teja se mile nava jīvana.
Annadātā tum jagata ke, Sakala jīva jīvana ke.

content.shloka:
Sandhya suraj praatah mein teja, Madhyahan mein parak parakash abh seja.
Saayam kaal laal prakash de, Jeevan chakra din raat base.
content.meaning: At dawn the sun gives its radiance, at noon a blazing illumination fills the sky. At evening you give a red light, the cycle of life through day and night is sustained.
content.transliteration:
Sandhyā sūraja prātaḥ meṁ teja, Madhyāhna meṁ paraka prakāśa abha sejā.
Sāyam kāla lāla prakāśa de, Jīvana cakra dina rāta base.

content.shloka:
Ritu kaal tum se hi aave, Fasal upaaj sab man bhaave.
Varsha sheetkal grishm sahare, Prakriti chakra tum se sab dhare.
content.meaning: The seasons come through you, crops and harvests that please all hearts. Rain, winter and summer are borne through you, the cycle of nature is sustained by you.
content.transliteration:
Ṛtu kāla tum se hī āve, Phasala upāja saba mana bhāve.
Varṣā śītakāla grīṣma sahāre, Prakṛti cakra tum se saba dhare.

content.shloka:
Chhath pooja mein pujit raho, Makar Sankranti mein jaape raho.
Rath Saptami mein viraje sada, Surya Grahan mein jaape sadaa.
content.meaning: You are worshipped in Chhath Puja, and chanted upon at Makar Sankranti. You preside ever on Ratha Saptami, and are invoked during solar eclipses.
content.transliteration:
Chaṭha pūjā meṁ pūjita raho, Makara Saṅkrānti meṁ jāpe raho.
Ratha Saptamī meṁ virāje sadā, Sūrya Grahaṇa meṁ jāpe sadā.

content.shloka:
Gayatri mantra tumhara roop, Savitar dev tej swaroop.
Suryanamaskar kare jo koi, Nirogi deha paave soi.
content.meaning: The Gayatri Mantra is your very form, Savitar Deva, embodiment of brilliance. Whoever performs Surya Namaskar attains a disease-free body.
content.transliteration:
Gāyatrī mantra tumhārā rūpa, Savitā deva teja svarūpa.
Sūryanamaskāra kare jo koī, Nirogī dehā pāve soī.

content.shloka:
Sugriv mitr bane Suryasut, Karna veer Suryadev ko put.
Yam Dharmaraj bhi tere nandan, Shani dev tere putr anandan.
content.meaning: Sugriva the friend was born of the Sun, the brave Karna was the Sun God's son. Yama Dharmaraj is also your offspring, Shani Dev is your joyful son.
content.transliteration:
Sugrīva mitra bane Sūryasuta, Karṇa vīra Sūryadeva ko puta.
Yama Dharmarāja bhī tere nandana, Śani deva tere putra ānandana.

content.shloka:
Rog naashak Surydev tumhi, Kushtha rog se bachavein tumhi.
Netra rog har lein Bhagvaan, Aarogya dein Suryanaraayan.
content.meaning: You are the destroyer of disease, O Sun God, you protect from skin afflictions. Remove eye diseases, O Lord, grant good health, O Suryanarayan.
content.transliteration:
Roga nāśaka Sūryadeva tumhī, Kuṣṭha roga se bacāveṁ tumhī.
Netra roga hara leṁ Bhagavāna, Ārogya deṁ Sūryanārāyaṇa.

content.shloka:
Jyotish shastra ke mool tumhi, Navagraha ke nayak tumhi.
Sakala graha tav aagya maanein, Tumhari kirno se bal jaanein.
content.meaning: You are the root of the science of astrology, you are the leader of the nine planets. All planets obey your command, from your rays they draw their strength.
content.transliteration:
Jyotiṣa śāstra ke mūla tumhī, Navagraha ke nāyaka tumhī.
Sakala graha tava ājñā māneṁ, Tumhārī kiraṇoṁ se bala jāneṁ.

content.shloka:
Surya dev ko arghya de, Lal pushp jal mein rahe.
Gur me gola ka bhog lagaye, Suryanarayan prasan ho jaaye.
content.meaning: Offer arghya (water oblation) to the Sun God, with red flowers placed in the water. Offer jaggery sweets as bhog, and Suryanarayan will be pleased.
content.transliteration:
Sūrya deva ko arghya de, Lāla puṣpa jala meṁ rahe.
Guḍa me golā kā bhoga lagāye, Sūryanārāyaṇa prasanna ho jāye.

content.shloka:
Tamo naashak tum jag mein aaye, Agyanata ka andhera mitaye.
Gyan deepak jala ujiyaar karo, Buddhi vivek ka bhav udhaar karo.
content.meaning: You came to the world as the destroyer of darkness, removing the shadow of ignorance. Light the lamp of knowledge and bring illumination, uplift the spirit of intellect and discernment.
content.transliteration:
Tamo nāśaka tum jaga meṁ āye, Ajñānatā kā andherā miṭāye.
Jñāna dīpaka jalā ujiyāra karo, Buddhi viveka kā bhava uddhāra karo.

content.shloka:
Sankat kate dukh door ho jaaye, Surya dev jab kripa dikhaaye.
Dhan dhaanya sampatti barse ghar, Arogya sukh mile nit sundar.
content.meaning: Troubles are cut and sorrows removed when the Sun God shows his grace. Wealth, grain and prosperity shower the home, health and happiness are received daily in abundance.
content.transliteration:
Saṅkaṭa kaṭe duḥkha dūra ho jāye, Sūrya deva jaba kṛpā dikhāye.
Dhana dhānya sampatti barase ghara, Ārogya sukha mile nita sundara.

content.shloka:
Surya chalisa padhe jo koi, Sankat bipada na rahe na koi.
Mann ki iccha poori ho jaave, Suryanaraayan mann bhaave.
|| Doha ||
Kashyap nandan Bhaskar Ravi, Prabhu tumhari jai ho.
Surya chalisa paath se, Sab dukh door sahai ho.
content.meaning:
Whoever recites the Surya Chalisa, neither calamity nor trouble shall remain. The wishes of the heart shall be fulfilled, Suryanarayan is pleased. 
|| Doha ||
O Bhaskar Ravi, son of Kashyap, victory be to you, Lord. Through the recitation of the Surya Chalisa, all sorrows are relieved.
content.transliteration:
Sūrya calīsā paḍhe jo koī, Saṅkaṭa bipadā na rahe na koī.
Mana kī icchā pūrī ho jāve, Sūryanārāyaṇa mana bhāve.
|| Dohā ||
Kaśyapa nandana Bhāskara Ravi, Prabhu tumhārī jai ho.
Sūrya calīsā pāṭha se, Saba duḥkha dūra sahāī ho.

content.shloka:
|| Doha ||
Jai Jai Santoshi Mata, tum ho kripa nidhan.
Sab dukh harani sukhdaani, karo sabka kalyaan.
|| Chaupai ||
content.meaning:
|| Doha ||
Victory, victory to Mother Santoshi, you are the treasury of grace. Remover of all sorrows, bestower of happiness, bring welfare to all.
|| Chaupai ||
content.transliteration:
|| Dohā ||
Jai Jai Santośī Mātā, tum ho kṛpā nidhāna.
Saba duḥkha hāraṇī sukhadānī, karo sabakā kalyāṇa.
|| Caupāī ||

content.shloka:
Jai Santoshi Mata Jagadamba, Tum ho Ganapati ki suta damba.
Siddhi Buddhi ki laadli, Santan ki sukhkaari pyaari.
content.meaning: Victory to Santoshi Mata, Mother of the Universe. You are the splendid daughter of Ganapati. The darling of Siddhi and Buddhi, the beloved one who brings happiness to children.
content.transliteration:
Jai Santośī Mātā Jagadambā, Tum ho Gaṇapati kī sutā dambā.
Siddhi Buddhi kī lāḍalī, Santana kī sukhakārī pyārī.

content.shloka:
Sunahari kaanti tan sobhe bhari, Laal vastra ki chhavi nyaari.
Singhasan par sushobhit raajein, Bhakt jan ke mann ko bhaajein.
content.meaning: Golden radiance fully adorns your body, the splendor of red garments is unique. You preside beautifully upon the throne, captivating the hearts of devotees.
content.transliteration:
Sunaharī kānti tana sobhe bharī, Lāla vastra kī chavi nyārī.
Siṁhāsana para suśobhita rājeṁ, Bhakta jana ke mana ko bhājeṁ.

content.shloka:
Hath mein talvar trishul viraaje, Aur ek haath mein kamal saje.
Gale mein pushp haar shobhit, Mukt mukta mani se shobhit.
content.meaning: A sword and trident adorn your hands, and in one hand a lotus is arranged. A garland of flowers graces your neck, radiant with pearls and gems.
content.transliteration:
Hātha meṁ talavāra triśūla virāje, Aura eka hātha meṁ kamala saje.
Gale meṁ puṣpa hāra śobhita, Mukta muktā maṇi se śobhita.

content.shloka:
Shukravar ko vrat jo kare koi, Uske ghar mein na rahe na dukh koi.
Gur chana ka prasad banaaye, Santoshi maa prasanna ho jaaye.
content.meaning: Whoever observes a fast on Friday, no sorrow shall remain in their home. Prepare the offering of jaggery and chickpeas, and Mother Santoshi will be pleased.
content.transliteration:
Śukravāra ko vrata jo kare koī, Usake ghara meṁ na rahe na duḥkha koī.
Guḍa canā kā prasāda banāye, Santośī mā prasanna ho jāye.

content.shloka:
Solah shukravar vrat kare, Mann vachhit phal paave nare.
Shradha preet se puja kare, Santoshi maa kaaj sab kare.
content.meaning: One who observes the fast for sixteen consecutive Fridays attains the desired fruit. One who worships with faith and devotion, Mother Santoshi accomplishes all their tasks.
content.transliteration:
Ṣoḍaśa śukravāra vrata kare, Mana vāñchita phala pāve nare.
Śraddhā prīta se pūjā kare, Santośī mā kāja saba kare.

content.shloka:
Dhan sampada ghar mein aave, Sukh shanti ka vaas ho jaave.
Grih klesha mite sab jaaye, Parivar mein prem badh jaaye.
content.meaning: Wealth and prosperity come into the home, peace and happiness take up residence. All domestic troubles are removed, love within the family increases.
content.transliteration:
Dhana sampadā ghara meṁ āve, Sukha śānti kā vāsa ho jāve.
Gṛha kleśa miṭe saba jāye, Parivāra meṁ prema baḍha jāye.

content.shloka:
Vivah mein baadha door karein, Santan sukh ko prakat karein.
Daampaty jeevan sukhmay kare, Santoshi maa kripa kare.
content.meaning: She removes obstacles in marriage, bestows the happiness of children. She makes married life blissful, Mother Santoshi grants her grace.
content.transliteration:
Vivāha meṁ bādhā dūra kareṁ, Santāna sukha ko prakaṭa kareṁ.
Dāmpatya jīvana sukhamaya kare, Santośī mā kṛpā kare.

content.shloka:
Jo koi deen dukhi tere dwaare, So sab sukh paave pyaare.
Kanganon mein kankan shobhe, Santoshi maa mann lobhe.
content.meaning: Whoever comes to your door, destitute and sorrowful, they all attain happiness, dear one. Bangles adorn the wrists, Mother Santoshi captivates the heart.
content.transliteration:
Jo koī dīna dukhī tere dvāre, So saba sukha pāve pyāre.
Kaṅganoṁ meṁ kaṅkana śobhe, Santośī mā mana lobhe.

content.shloka:
Saubhagya ki tum daayini ho, Suhaag ki tum raakhani ho.
Grihasthi ka sukh de do mata, Aashirwaad de do vidhata.
content.meaning: You are the bestower of good fortune, you are the protector of marital bliss. Grant the happiness of household life, O Mother, bestow your blessings, O Creator.
content.transliteration:
Saubhāgya kī tum dāyinī ho, Suhāga kī tum rākhanī ho.
Gṛhasthī kā sukha de do mātā, Āśīrvāda de do vidhātā.

content.shloka:
Garib nivaaj dayal Mata, Dushtan mardini Jag vikhyata.
Bhakt vatsala tum karunamayi, Sab ki Mata Santoshi samayi.
content.meaning: Protector of the poor, compassionate Mother, crusher of the wicked, famous throughout the world. You are tender towards devotees and full of mercy, Mother Santoshi is the mother of all, all-pervading.
content.transliteration:
Garība nivāja dayāla Mātā, Duṣṭana mardinī Jaga vikhyātā.
Bhakta vatsalā tum karuṇāmayī, Saba kī Mātā Santośī samayī.

content.shloka:
Aarti utaare mann lagaaye, Sankat kate Mata sukh paaye.
Puja archana vidhi se kare, Santoshi maa ashish bhare.
content.meaning: Perform aarti with a focused mind, Mother removes troubles and grants happiness. Worship with proper rituals, and Mother Santoshi fills you with blessings.
content.transliteration:
Āratī utāre mana lagāye, Saṅkaṭa kaṭe Mātā sukha pāye.
Pūjā arcanā vidhi se kare, Santośī mā āśīṣa bhare.

content.shloka:
Nirdhan ko dhan sampada de, Rogee ko arogya tan de.
Dukhi ko sukh shanti de Mata, Sab ki bigdi banaye Vidhata.
content.meaning: She gives wealth and prosperity to the poor, grants a healthy body to the sick. Give happiness and peace to the sorrowful, O Mother, the Creator who sets right all that has gone wrong.
content.transliteration:
Nirdhana ko dhana sampadā de, Rogī ko ārogya tana de.
Dukhī ko sukha śānti de Mātā, Saba kī bigaḍī banāye Vidhātā.

content.shloka:
Katha sunein Mata ki pyaari, Vrat niyam palein naari.
Sukh saubhagya se ghar bhare, Santoshi maa kaaj sab kare.
content.meaning: Hear the beloved story of the Mother, women should observe fasts and disciplines. The home fills with happiness and fortune, Mother Santoshi accomplishes all tasks.
content.transliteration:
Kathā suneṁ Mātā kī pyārī, Vrata niyama paleṁ nārī.
Sukha saubhāgya se ghara bhare, Santośī mā kāja saba kare.

content.shloka:
Ganapati nandan Santoshi Maiya, Bhakton ko de do sahaiya.
Sab sankat door karo Mata, Tum ho sab ki sukhdata.
content.meaning: O Santoshi Maiya, daughter of Ganapati, give support to your devotees. Remove all troubles, O Mother, you are the giver of happiness to all.
content.transliteration:
Gaṇapati nandana Santośī Maiyā, Bhaktoṁ ko de do sahāiyā.
Saba saṅkaṭa dūra karo Mātā, Tum ho saba kī sukhadātā.

content.shloka:
Mann mein shradha bhakti jagaaye, Santoshi maa ke geet sunaaye.
Prempoorvak jo dhyaan lagaaye, Mann vachhit phal avashya paaye.
content.meaning: Awaken faith and devotion in the heart, sing the songs of Mother Santoshi. One who meditates with love surely obtains the desired fruit.
content.transliteration:
Mana meṁ śraddhā bhakti jagāye, Santośī mā ke gīta sunāye.
Premapūrvaka jo dhyāna lagāye, Mana vāñchita phala avaśya pāye.

content.shloka:
Santoshi Mata ki jai bolo, Jai jai jai sur naar bolo.
Sab mein samaan darshan karo, Santoshi Mata mein man dharo.
content.meaning: Proclaim the victory of Mother Santoshi, say victory, victory, victory, O gods and humans. See her equally in all, place your heart in Mother Santoshi.
content.transliteration:
Santośī Mātā kī jai bolo, Jai jai jai sura nāra bolo.
Saba meṁ samāna darśana karo, Santośī Mātā meṁ mana dharo.

content.shloka:
Jo yeh chalisa padhe sunaave, Santoshi Mata kripa barasaave.
Ghar mein sukh shanti aave sada, Kabhi na aave koi aapda.
|| Doha ||
Santoshi chalisa padhe, mann mein kare vichaara.
Mata prasanna ho sada, kare bhakton ka uddhaar.
Jai Santoshi Mata Jai Jai Santoshi Mata.
content.meaning:
One who recites or listens to this chalisa, Mother Santoshi showers her grace. Happiness and peace forever fill the home, no calamity ever comes.
|| Doha ||
One who recites the Santoshi Chalisa with reflection in the heart, the Mother is always pleased and delivers her devotees. Victory to Mother Santoshi, victory, victory to Mother Santoshi.
content.transliteration:
Jo yaha calīsā paḍhe sunāve, Santośī Mātā kṛpā barasāve.
Ghara meṁ sukha śānti āve sadā, Kabhī na āve koī āpadā.
|| Dohā ||
Santośī calīsā paḍhe, mana meṁ kare vicāra.
Mātā prasanna ho sadā, kare bhaktoṁ kā uddhāra.
Jai Santośī Mātā Jai Jai Santośī Mātā.
